1594:+/-!
1595:+# Rewriting rules for dependent mixtures of finite distributions
1596:+
1597:+This module records the elementary rewriting rules for the dependent mixture
1598:+of finite distributions that the sampling procedure of the sub-line lemma
1599:+uses: a mixture indexed along a push-forward is the mixture indexed along the
1600:+original law, iterated mixtures associate, a mixture is unchanged when the
1601:+mixed family is changed only outside the index support, a mixture of a
1602:+constant family is that constant, a product with a fixed independent factor
1603:+distributes over a mixture, and an equal two-term mixture is the mixture
1604:+indexed by a uniform pair of labels.
1605:+
1606:+## References
1607:+
1608:+The rewriting rules support `lem:qld-sublines` in
1609:+blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, whose source is
1610:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`.
1611:+The mixture, product and equal-mixture operations are those of
1612:+blueprint `def:line-point-dist`.
1613:+-/
1614:+
1615:+open scoped BigOperators
1616:+
1617:+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
1618:+
1619:+open MIPStarRE.LDT
1620:+
1621:+noncomputable section
1622:+
1623:+/-! ## Reindexing a dependent mixture -/
1624:+
1625:+/-- Mixing along a push-forward index is mixing along the original index.
1626:+Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
1627:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
1628:+theorem Distribution.bind_map_left {α β γ : Type*} [DecidableEq β]
1629:+    [DecidableEq γ] (μ : Distribution α) (f : α → β) (ν : β → Distribution γ) :
1630:+    Distribution.bind (μ.map f) ν =
1631:+      Distribution.bind μ (fun a => ν (f a)) := by
1632:+  classical
1633:+  refine Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight ?_ ?_
1634:+  · change (μ.support.image f).biUnion (fun b => (ν b).support) =
1635:+      μ.support.biUnion (fun a => (ν (f a)).support)
1636:+    ext c
1637:+    simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_image]
1638:+    constructor
1639:+    · rintro ⟨b, ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩, hc⟩
1640:+      exact ⟨a, ha, hc⟩
1641:+    · rintro ⟨a, ha, hc⟩
1642:+      exact ⟨f a, ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩, hc⟩
1643:+  · funext c
1644:+    change (∑ b ∈ μ.support.image f, (μ.map f).weight b * (ν b).weight c) =
1645:+      ∑ a ∈ μ.support, μ.weight a * (ν (f a)).weight c
1646:+    rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
1647:+      (s := μ.support) (t := μ.support.image f) (g := f)
1648:+      (fun a ha => Finset.mem_image_of_mem f ha)
1649:+      (fun a => μ.weight a * (ν (f a)).weight c)]
1650:+    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
1651:+    rw [Distribution.map_weight, Finset.sum_mul]
1652:+    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a ha => ?_
1653:+    rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2]
1654:+
1655:+/-- A dependent mixture depends on the mixed family only on the index
1656:+support.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
1657:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
1658:+theorem Distribution.bind_congr_support {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq β]
1659:+    (μ : Distribution α) (ν ν' : α → Distribution β)
1660:+    (h : ∀ a ∈ μ.support, ν a = ν' a) :
1661:+    Distribution.bind μ ν = Distribution.bind μ ν' := by
1662:+  refine Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight ?_ ?_
1663:+  · change μ.support.biUnion (fun a => (ν a).support) =
1664:+      μ.support.biUnion (fun a => (ν' a).support)
1665:+    exact Finset.biUnion_congr rfl fun a ha => by rw [h a ha]
1666:+  · funext b
1667:+    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a ha => by rw [h a ha]
1668:+
1669:+/-- A dependent mixture of a constant family is that constant law.  Blueprint
1670:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
1671:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
1672:+theorem Distribution.bind_const {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq β]
1673:+    (μ : Distribution α) (hμ : μ.IsProbability) (ν : Distribution β) :
1674:+    Distribution.bind μ (fun _ => ν) = ν := by
1675:+  have hne : μ.support.Nonempty := by
1676:+    rw [← Finset.card_pos]
1677:+    by_contra hcard
1678:+    have hempty : μ.support = ∅ := by
1679:+      rw [← Finset.card_eq_zero]
1680:+      omega
1681:+    have h1 := hμ.weight_sum_eq_one
1682:+    rw [hempty] at h1
1683:+    simp at h1
1684:+  refine Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight ?_ ?_
1685:+  · change μ.support.biUnion (fun _ => ν.support) = ν.support
1686:+    ext b
1687:+    simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion]
1688:+    constructor
1689:+    · rintro ⟨a, -, hb⟩
1690:+      exact hb
1691:+    · intro hb
1692:+      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hne
1693:+      exact ⟨a, ha, hb⟩
1694:+  · funext b
1695:+    change (∑ a ∈ μ.support, μ.weight a * ν.weight b) = ν.weight b
1696:+    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hμ.weight_sum_eq_one, one_mul]

1698:+/-! ## Associativity of dependent mixtures -/
1699:+
1700:+/-- Iterated dependent mixtures associate.  Blueprint
1701:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
1702:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
1703:+theorem Distribution.bind_bind {α β γ : Type*} [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]
1704:+    (μ : Distribution α) (ν : α → Distribution β) (ρ : β → Distribution γ) :
1705:+    Distribution.bind (Distribution.bind μ ν) ρ =
1706:+      Distribution.bind μ (fun a => Distribution.bind (ν a) ρ) := by
1707:+  classical
1708:+  refine Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight ?_ ?_
1709:+  · change (μ.support.biUnion (fun a => (ν a).support)).biUnion
1710:+        (fun b => (ρ b).support) =
1711:+      μ.support.biUnion (fun a => (ν a).support.biUnion (fun b => (ρ b).support))
1712:+    ext c
1713:+    simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion]
1714:+    constructor
1715:+    · rintro ⟨b, ⟨a, ha, hb⟩, hc⟩
1716:+      exact ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hc⟩
1717:+    · rintro ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hc⟩
1718:+      exact ⟨b, ⟨a, ha, hb⟩, hc⟩
1719:+  · funext c
1720:+    change (∑ b ∈ μ.support.biUnion (fun a => (ν a).support),
1721:+        (∑ a ∈ μ.support, μ.weight a * (ν a).weight b) * (ρ b).weight c) =
1722:+      ∑ a ∈ μ.support, μ.weight a *
1723:+        ∑ b ∈ (ν a).support, (ν a).weight b * (ρ b).weight c
1724:+    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ =>
1725:+      Finset.sum_mul μ.support (fun a => μ.weight a * (ν a).weight b)
1726:+        ((ρ b).weight c), Finset.sum_comm]
1727:+    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a ha => ?_
1728:+    have hsub : (ν a).support ⊆ μ.support.biUnion (fun a => (ν a).support) :=
1729:+      fun b hb => Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨a, ha, hb⟩
1730:+    have hzero : ∀ b ∈ μ.support.biUnion (fun a => (ν a).support),
1731:+        b ∉ (ν a).support →
1732:+        μ.weight a * ((ν a).weight b * (ρ b).weight c) = 0 := by
1733:+      intro b _ hbnot
1734:+      rw [(ν a).outsideSupport b hbnot, zero_mul, mul_zero]
1735:+    rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_subset hsub hzero]
1736:+    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => mul_assoc _ _ _

1739:+
1740:+/-- A product with a fixed independent second factor distributes over a
1741:+dependent mixture of the first factor.  Blueprint
1742:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper

1744:+theorem Distribution.prod_bind_left {α β γ : Type*} [DecidableEq β]
1745:+    [DecidableEq γ] (μ : Distribution α) (ν : α → Distribution β)
1746:+    (ρ : Distribution γ) :
1747:+    Distribution.prod (Distribution.bind μ ν) ρ =
1748:+      Distribution.bind μ (fun a => Distribution.prod (ν a) ρ) := by
1749:+  classical
1750:+  refine Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight ?_ ?_
1751:+  · change (μ.support.biUnion (fun a => (ν a).support)) ×ˢ ρ.support =
1752:+      μ.support.biUnion (fun a => (ν a).support ×ˢ ρ.support)
1753:+    ext w
1754:+    simp only [Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_biUnion]
1755:+    constructor
1756:+    · rintro ⟨⟨a, ha, hb⟩, hc⟩
1757:+      exact ⟨a, ha, hb, hc⟩
1758:+    · rintro ⟨a, ha, hb, hc⟩
1759:+      exact ⟨⟨a, ha, hb⟩, hc⟩
1760:+  · funext w
1761:+    change (∑ a ∈ μ.support, μ.weight a * (ν a).weight w.1) * ρ.weight w.2 =
1762:+      ∑ a ∈ μ.support, μ.weight a * ((ν a).weight w.1 * ρ.weight w.2)
1763:+    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
1764:+    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => mul_assoc _ _ _

1768:+/-- The equal mixture of two laws is the dependent mixture indexed by a
1769:+uniform pair of labels.  Blueprint `def:line-point-dist`, paper
1770:+`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:274-287`.

1772:+theorem Distribution.bind_uniform_fin_two {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
1773:+    (μ ν : Distribution α) :
1774:+    Distribution.bind (uniformDistribution (Fin 2)) ![μ, ν] =
1775:+      Distribution.mix (1 / 2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) μ ν := by
1776:+  classical
1777:+  refine Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight ?_ ?_
1778:+  · change (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)).biUnion
1779:+        (fun i => (![μ, ν] i).support) = μ.support ∪ ν.support
1780:+    ext a
1781:+    simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_union]
1782:+    constructor
1783:+    · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
1784:+      fin_cases i
1785:+      · exact Or.inl hi
1786:+      · exact Or.inr hi
1787:+    · rintro (h | h)
1788:+      · exact ⟨0, h⟩
1789:+      · exact ⟨1, h⟩
1790:+  · funext a
1791:+    change (∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)),
1792:+        (uniformDistribution (Fin 2)).weight i * (![μ, ν] i).weight a) =
1793:+      1 / 2 * μ.weight a + (1 - 1 / 2) * ν.weight a
1794:+    rw [Fin.sum_univ_two, uniformDistribution_weight_apply,
1795:+      uniformDistribution_weight_apply, Fintype.card_fin]
1796:+    norm_num
1797:+
1798:+end

1810:+/-!
1811:+# Independent blocks of the restricted line-point laws
1812:+
1813:+This module isolates the independent generating blocks of the restricted
1814:+line-point laws used by the sampling procedure of the sub-line lemma.  A
1815:+uniformly sampled low-degree vector splits into a point block and a
1816:+seed-direction block; the coordinate-index event constrains only the second
1817:+block, so conditioning on it leaves the point block uniform and independent.
1818:+The conditioned seed-direction block is the fresh diagonal direction pair of
1819:+the sub-line construction, and the uniform mixture of those pairs over the
1820:+coordinate index is the unconditioned law.
1821:+
1822:+## References
1823:+
1824:+The generating descriptions support `lem:qld-sublines` in
1825:+blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, whose source is
1826:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`.
1827:+The restricted laws themselves are `def:ith-restricted-line`, blueprint lines
1828:+1209--1228, paper lines 1038--1048.
1829:+-/
1830:+

1839:+/-! ## Uniform laws on products -/
1840:+
1841:+/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the uniform law on a product of two finite
1842:+types is the product of the uniform laws.  Blueprint
1843:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
1844:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
1845:+theorem uniformDistribution_prod (α β : Type*) [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
1846:+    [Nonempty α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Nonempty β] :
1847:+    uniformDistribution (α × β) =
1848:+      Distribution.prod (uniformDistribution α) (uniformDistribution β) := by
1849:+  classical
1850:+  have ha : (Fintype.card α : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
1851:+    exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero (α := α)
1852:+  have hb : (Fintype.card β : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
1853:+    exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero (α := β)
1854:+  refine Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight ?_ ?_
1855:+  · show (Finset.univ : Finset (α × β)) =
1856:+      (Finset.univ : Finset α).product (Finset.univ : Finset β)
1857:+    ext p
1858:+    simp
1859:+  · funext p
1860:+    show (uniformDistribution (α × β)).weight p =
1861:+      (uniformDistribution α).weight p.1 * (uniformDistribution β).weight p.2
1862:+    rw [uniformDistribution_weight_apply, uniformDistribution_weight_apply,
1863:+      uniformDistribution_weight_apply, Fintype.card_prod]
1864:+    push_cast
1865:+    field_simp
1866:+
1867:+/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the mass of an event depending only on the
1868:+second factor is the same under a uniform product law and under the uniform
1869:+law of that factor.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
1870:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
1871:+theorem uniformDistribution_snd_event_mass {α β : Type*} [Fintype α]
1872:+    [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Nonempty β]
1873:+    (p : β → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
1874:+    ∑ w ∈ (uniformDistribution (α × β)).support.filter (fun w => p w.2),
1875:+        (uniformDistribution (α × β)).weight w =
1876:+      ∑ b ∈ (uniformDistribution β).support.filter p,
1877:+        (uniformDistribution β).weight b := by
1878:+  classical
1879:+  rw [Distribution.sum_filter_weight_eq_avgOver,
1880:+    Distribution.sum_filter_weight_eq_avgOver,
1881:+    ← uniformDistribution_map_snd (α := α) (β := β), Distribution.avgOver_map]

1883:+/-! ## Conditioning one factor of a product -/
1884:+
1885:+/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: normalized restriction depends on the
1886:+restricted law only through its support and weights.  Blueprint
1887:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
1888:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
1889:+theorem Distribution.restrict_congr {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
1890:+    {μ ν : Distribution α} (h : μ = ν) (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
1891:+    (hμ : 0 < ∑ a ∈ μ.support.filter p, μ.weight a)
1892:+    (hν : 0 < ∑ a ∈ ν.support.filter p, ν.weight a) :
1893:+    Distribution.restrict μ p hμ = Distribution.restrict ν p hν := by
1894:+  subst h
1895:+  rfl
1896:+
1897:+/-- Restricting a product law to an event depending on the second factor alone
1898:+leaves the first factor unchanged and independent of the conditioned second
1899:+factor.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
1900:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
1901:+theorem Distribution.restrict_prod_snd {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
1902:+    [DecidableEq β] (μ : Distribution α) (ν : Distribution β)
1903:+    (hμ : μ.IsProbability) (p : β → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
1904:+    (hpos : 0 < ∑ b ∈ ν.support.filter p, ν.weight b)
1905:+    (hpos' : 0 < ∑ w ∈ (Distribution.prod μ ν).support.filter
1906:+        (fun w => p w.2), (Distribution.prod μ ν).weight w) :
1907:+    Distribution.restrict (Distribution.prod μ ν) (fun w => p w.2) hpos' =
1908:+      Distribution.prod μ (Distribution.restrict ν p hpos) := by
1909:+  classical
1910:+  have hprodsupp : (Distribution.prod μ ν).support =
1911:+      μ.support ×ˢ ν.support := rfl
1912:+  have hsupp : (Distribution.prod μ ν).support.filter (fun w => p w.2) =
1913:+      μ.support ×ˢ (ν.support.filter p) := by
1914:+    rw [hprodsupp]
1915:+    ext w
1916:+    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product]
1917:+    tauto
1918:+  have hmass : (∑ w ∈ (Distribution.prod μ ν).support.filter
1919:+        (fun w => p w.2), (Distribution.prod μ ν).weight w) =
1920:+      ∑ b ∈ ν.support.filter p, ν.weight b := by
1921:+    rw [hsupp]
1922:+    have h1 : (∑ w ∈ μ.support ×ˢ (ν.support.filter p),
1923:+        (Distribution.prod μ ν).weight w) =
1924:+        ∑ a ∈ μ.support, ∑ b ∈ ν.support.filter p,
1925:+          μ.weight a * ν.weight b := by
1926:+      rw [Finset.sum_product]
1927:+      rfl
1928:+    rw [h1, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ =>
1929:+        (Finset.mul_sum (ν.support.filter p) (fun b => ν.weight b)
1930:+          (μ.weight a)).symm,
1931:+      ← Finset.sum_mul, hμ.weight_sum_eq_one, one_mul]
1932:+  refine Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight ?_ ?_
1933:+  · show (Distribution.prod μ ν).support.filter (fun w => p w.2) =
1934:+      μ.support ×ˢ (ν.support.filter p)
1935:+    exact hsupp
1936:+  · funext w
1937:+    show (if p w.2 then (Distribution.prod μ ν).weight w /
1938:+        ∑ c ∈ (Distribution.prod μ ν).support.filter (fun w => p w.2),
1939:+          (Distribution.prod μ ν).weight c else 0) =
1940:+      μ.weight w.1 * (if p w.2 then ν.weight w.2 /
1941:+        ∑ c ∈ ν.support.filter p, ν.weight c else 0)
1942:+    rw [hmass]
1943:+    by_cases h : p w.2
1944:+    · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h]
1945:+      show μ.weight w.1 * ν.weight w.2 / _ = _
1946:+      rw [mul_div_assoc]
1947:+    · rw [if_neg h, if_neg h, mul_zero]
1948:+
1949:+/-- Conditioning a uniform product law on an event of its second factor leaves
1950:+the first factor uniform and independent.  Blueprint
1951:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
1952:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
1953:+theorem restrict_uniform_prod_snd {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
1954:+    [Nonempty α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Nonempty β] (p : β → Prop)
1955:+    [DecidablePred p]
1956:+    (hpos : 0 < ∑ b ∈ (uniformDistribution β).support.filter p,
1957:+      (uniformDistribution β).weight b)
1958:+    (hpos' : 0 < ∑ w ∈ (uniformDistribution (α × β)).support.filter
1959:+        (fun w => p w.2), (uniformDistribution (α × β)).weight w) :
1960:+    Distribution.restrict (uniformDistribution (α × β)) (fun w => p w.2)
1961:+        hpos' =
1962:+      Distribution.prod (uniformDistribution α)
1963:+        (Distribution.restrict (uniformDistribution β) p hpos) := by
1964:+  classical
1965:+  have hpos'' : 0 < ∑ w ∈ (Distribution.prod (uniformDistribution α)
1966:+        (uniformDistribution β)).support.filter (fun w => p w.2),
1967:+      (Distribution.prod (uniformDistribution α)
1968:+        (uniformDistribution β)).weight w := by
1969:+    rw [← uniformDistribution_prod]
1970:+    exact hpos'
1971:+  rw [Distribution.restrict_congr (uniformDistribution_prod α β)
1972:+    (fun w => p w.2) hpos' hpos'']
1973:+  exact Distribution.restrict_prod_snd _ _
1974:+    (uniformDistribution_isProbability α) p hpos hpos''

1976:+/-! ## The block decomposition of an ambient low-degree vector -/
1977:+
1978:+/-- Split an ambient low-degree vector into its point block and its
1979:+seed-direction block.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
1980:+`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`. -/
1981:+def ldSpaceBlockEquiv (L : LdParams) :
1982:+    LdSpace L ≃
1983:+      (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) × (ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L)) where
1984:+  toFun z := (LdSpace.point z, LdSpace.seed z, LdSpace.direction z)
1985:+  invFun w := fun i =>
1986:+    match i with
1987:+    | .inl (.inl j) => w.1 j
1988:+    | .inl (.inr _) => w.2.1
1989:+    | .inr j => w.2.2 j
1990:+  left_inv z := by
1991:+    funext i
1992:+    rcases i with (j | u) | j <;> rfl
1993:+  right_inv w := rfl

1995:+/-- The coordinate-index event of `def:ith-restricted-line` read on the
1996:+seed-direction block of an ambient low-degree vector.  Blueprint
1997:+`def:ith-restricted-line`, paper
1998:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1038-1048`. -/
1999:+def ldSeedDirEvent (L : LdParams) (i : Fin L.m)
2000:+    (sw : ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L)) : Prop :=
2001:+  chiIndex L sw.1 = i

2003:+/-- Decidability of the coordinate-index event on the seed-direction block. -/
2004:+instance ldSeedDirEvent_decidablePred (L : LdParams) (i : Fin L.m) :
2005:+    DecidablePred (ldSeedDirEvent L i) := by
2006:+  intro sw
2007:+  unfold ldSeedDirEvent
2008:+  infer_instance

2010:+/-- Each coordinate-index event of the seed-direction block carries mass
2011:+`1 / m` under the uniform law, because the retained seed is uniform and its
2012:+`m` coordinate-index fibers are equal.  Blueprint
2013:+`lem:restricted-line-mixture-bounds`, paper
2014:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1049-1051`. -/
2015:+theorem ldSeedDirEvent_mass (L : LdParams) (i : Fin L.m) :
2016:+    ∑ sw ∈ (uniformDistribution
2017:+          (ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L))).support.filter
2018:+        (ldSeedDirEvent L i),
2019:+        (uniformDistribution
2020:+          (ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L))).weight sw =
2021:+      1 / (L.m : ℝ) := by
2022:+  classical
2023:+  have hmap : (uniformDistribution
2024:+        (ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L))).map
2025:+        (fun sw => chiIndex L sw.1) = uniformDistribution (Fin L.m) := by
2026:+    rw [← Distribution.map_map _ Prod.fst (chiIndex L),
2027:+      uniformDistribution_map_fst, uniformDistribution_map_chiIndex]
2028:+  rw [Distribution.sum_filter_weight_eq_avgOver,
2029:+    show (fun sw : ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) =>
2030:+        if ldSeedDirEvent L i sw then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
2031:+      fun sw => (fun j : Fin L.m => if j = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
2032:+        (chiIndex L sw.1) from rfl,
2033:+    ← Distribution.avgOver_map
2034:+      (uniformDistribution (ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L)))
2035:+      (fun sw => chiIndex L sw.1)
2036:+      (fun j : Fin L.m => if j = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0), hmap]
2037:+  unfold avgOver
2038:+  simp [uniformDistribution_weight_apply, mul_ite]

2045:+          (ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L))).support.filter

2054:+/-! ## Fresh diagonal direction pairs -/

2056:+/-- The fresh diagonal direction pair at coordinate index `i`: a scalar seed
2057:+uniform in the fiber of `i` together with a direction block uniform on the
2058:+whole space.  This is the auxiliary randomness of the sampling procedure of

2063:+  Distribution.restrict
2064:+    (uniformDistribution (ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L)))

2073:+direction pairs is the unconditioned uniform seed-direction law.  Blueprint

2075:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/

2081:+    (ldSeedDirEvent_positive L)
2082:+    (fun i => by rw [ldSeedDirEvent_mass, Fintype.card_fin])

2087:+/-- Conditioning the uniform ambient low-degree law on the coordinate-index
2088:+event of its seed leaves the point block uniform and independent of the fresh
2089:+diagonal direction pair carried by the seed-direction block.  Blueprint
2090:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
2091:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
2092:+theorem restrict_uniform_ldSeedEvent_map_block (L : LdParams) (i : Fin L.m) :

2124:+/-- The axis-line decoder read on the block decomposition. -/

2126:+    (w : (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) × (ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L))) :

2132:+    (w : (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) × (ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L)))  :
2133:+    LineDesc L :=
2134:+  dLineDescOf L ((ldSpaceBlockEquiv L).symm w)

2136:+/-- The `i`-th restricted axis-line law is the law of the canonical
2137:+axis-parallel line through a uniform point block, in the coordinate direction
2138:+named by an independent fresh diagonal direction pair at index `i`, together
2139:+with that same point.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
2140:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
2141:+theorem restrictedALineDist_eq_map_prod (L : LdParams) (i : Fin L.m) :
2142:+    restrictedALineDist L i =
2143:+      (Distribution.prod (uniformDistribution (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L))
2144:+          (freshDiagonalPairDist L i)).map
2145:+        (fun w => (aLineDescOfBlock L w, w.1)) := by
2146:+  classical
2147:+  have hfun : (fun z : LdSpace L =>
2148:+        (aLineDescOfBlock L (ldSpaceBlockEquiv L z),
2149:+          (ldSpaceBlockEquiv L z).1)) =
2150:+      fun z : LdSpace L => (aLineDescOf L z, LdSpace.point z) := by
2151:+    funext z
2152:+    have h : (ldSpaceBlockEquiv L).symm (ldSpaceBlockEquiv L z) = z :=
2153:+      (ldSpaceBlockEquiv L).symm_apply_apply z
2154:+    show (aLineDescOf L ((ldSpaceBlockEquiv L).symm (ldSpaceBlockEquiv L z)),
2155:+        LdSpace.point z) = (aLineDescOf L z, LdSpace.point z)
2156:+    rw [h]
2157:+  rw [restrictedALineDist_eq_map_restrict,
2158:+    ← restrict_uniform_ldSeedEvent_map_block, Distribution.map_map, hfun]

2161:+diagonal line through a uniform point block, in the prefix-projected direction

2163:+that same point.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
2164:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/

2167:+      (Distribution.prod (uniformDistribution (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L))
2168:+          (freshDiagonalPairDist L i)).map
2169:+        (fun w => (dLineDescOfBlock L w, w.1)) := by
2170:+  classical
2171:+  have hfun : (fun z : LdSpace L =>
2172:+        (dLineDescOfBlock L (ldSpaceBlockEquiv L z),
2173:+          (ldSpaceBlockEquiv L z).1)) =
2174:+      fun z : LdSpace L => (dLineDescOf L z, LdSpace.point z) := by
2175:+    funext z
2176:+    have h : (ldSpaceBlockEquiv L).symm (ldSpaceBlockEquiv L z) = z :=
2177:+      (ldSpaceBlockEquiv L).symm_apply_apply z
2178:+    show (dLineDescOf L ((ldSpaceBlockEquiv L).symm (ldSpaceBlockEquiv L z)),
2179:+        LdSpace.point z) = (dLineDescOf L z, LdSpace.point z)
2180:+    rw [h]
2181:+  rw [restrictedDLineDist_eq_map_restrict,
2182:+    ← restrict_uniform_ldSeedEvent_map_block, Distribution.map_map, hfun]

2195:+/-!
2196:+# The branch data of the sub-line sampling procedure
2197:+
2198:+The sampling procedure of the sub-line lemma draws a line kind, a stored
2199:+extended coordinate, and an unrestricted extended direction, and forms from
2200:+them the direction of the extended line: the elementary direction at the
2201:+stored coordinate in the axis branch, and the extended direction with the
2202:+coordinates preceding the stored coordinate replaced by zero in the diagonal
2203:+branch.  The two source lines are then read off the two coordinate blocks.
2204:+This module fixes the coordinate index that each source line must carry: the
2205:+stored coordinate itself when it belongs to that block, the first coordinate
2206:+otherwise.  With that choice the source block of the extended direction always
2207:+lies in the line spanned by the corresponding source direction, which is the
2208:+incidence hypothesis of the two projection lemmas.  The module also records
2209:+that moving an extended point to its canonical representative does not change
2210:+the canonical representative of either of its source blocks.
2211:+
2212:+## References
2213:+
2214:+The statements support `lem:qld-sublines` in
2215:+blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, whose source is
2216:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`.
2217:+The coordinate blocks are those of `def:combine-map`, blueprint lines
2218:+445--480, paper lines 970--989; the prefix truncation is that of
2219:+blueprint `def:ld-question-distribution`.
2220:+-/
2221:+
2222:+open scoped BigOperators
2223:+
2224:+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
2225:+
2226:+open MIPStarRE.LDT
2227:+
2228:+noncomputable section
2229:+
2230:+/-! ## The three ranges of extended coordinates -/
2231:+
2232:+/-- Every extended coordinate is an `X`-block coordinate, a `Z`-block
2233:+coordinate, or one of the two scalar coordinates.  Blueprint
2234:+`def:combine-map`, paper
2235:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:970-989`. -/
2236:+theorem extendedCoordinate_cases (m : ℕ) (k : Fin (2 * m + 2)) :
2237:+    (∃ i : Fin m, k = embX m i) ∨ (∃ j : Fin m, k = embZ m j) ∨
2238:+      k = alphaVar m ∨ k = betaVar m := by
2239:+  rcases lt_or_ge k.val m with hk | hk
2240:+  · exact Or.inl ⟨⟨k.val, hk⟩, Fin.ext (embX_val m ⟨k.val, hk⟩).symm⟩
2241:+  · rcases lt_or_ge k.val (2 * m) with hk2 | hk2
2242:+    · refine Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨⟨k.val - m, by omega⟩, Fin.ext ?_⟩)
2243:+      rw [embZ_val]
2244:+      change k.val = m + (k.val - m)
2245:+      omega
2246:+    · have hk3 : k.val < 2 * m + 2 := k.isLt
2247:+      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k.val (2 * m + 1) with hk4 | hk4
2248:+      · refine Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (Fin.ext ?_)))
2249:+        rw [alphaVar_val]
2250:+        omega
2251:+      · refine Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Fin.ext ?_)))
2252:+        rw [betaVar_val]
2253:+        omega
2254:+
2255:+/-! ## Linearity of the identification of the two scalar fields -/
2256:+
2257:+/-- The identification of the two scalar fields is additive on extended
2258:+points.  Blueprint `def:combine-map`, paper
2259:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:970-989`. -/
2260:+theorem directPointToPauli_add (P : AdmissibleParams)
2261:+    (u v : Fin P.extendedDirectLd.m → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd) :
2262:+    directPointToPauli P (u + v) =
2263:+      directPointToPauli P u + directPointToPauli P v := by
2264:+  funext i
2265:+  simp [directPointToPauli]
2266:+
2267:+/-- The identification of the two scalar fields carries a scalar multiple of
2268:+an extended point to the multiple by the identified scalar.  Blueprint
2269:+`def:combine-map`, paper
2270:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:970-989`. -/
2271:+theorem directPointToPauli_smul (P : AdmissibleParams)
2272:+    (t : DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd)
2273:+    (u : Fin P.extendedDirectLd.m → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd) :
2274:+    directPointToPauli P (t • u) =
2275:+      extendedDirectScalarEquiv P t • directPointToPauli P u := by
2276:+  funext i
2277:+  simp [directPointToPauli]

2279:+/-! ## The coordinate index carried by each source line -/
2280:+
2281:+/-- The first coordinate of the source space.  Blueprint
2282:+`eq:chi-func`, paper
2283:+`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:958-961`.
2284:+-/
2285:+def subLineFirstIndex (P : AdmissibleParams) : Fin P.m :=
2286:+  ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one P.one_le_m⟩
2287:+
2288:+/-- The coordinate index carried by the source `X` line of a branch: the
2289:+stored extended coordinate when it is an `X`-block coordinate, and the first
2290:+coordinate otherwise.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
2291:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
2292:+def subLineXIndex (P : AdmissibleParams) (k : Fin (2 * P.m + 2)) : Fin P.m :=
2293:+  if h : k.val < P.m then ⟨k.val, h⟩ else subLineFirstIndex P
2294:+
2295:+/-- The coordinate index carried by the source `Z` line of a branch: the
2296:+stored extended coordinate when it is a `Z`-block coordinate, and the first
2297:+coordinate otherwise.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
2298:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
2299:+def subLineZIndex (P : AdmissibleParams) (k : Fin (2 * P.m + 2)) : Fin P.m :=
2300:+  if h : P.m ≤ k.val ∧ k.val < 2 * P.m then ⟨k.val - P.m, by omega⟩
2301:+  else subLineFirstIndex P
2302:+
2303:+/-- At an `X`-block coordinate the source `X` line carries that coordinate. -/
2304:+theorem subLineXIndex_embX (P : AdmissibleParams) (i : Fin P.m) :
2305:+    subLineXIndex P (embX P.m i) = i := by
2306:+  have h : (embX P.m i).val < P.m := by
2307:+    rw [embX_val]
2308:+    exact i.isLt
2309:+  rw [subLineXIndex, dif_pos h]
2310:+  exact Fin.ext (embX_val P.m i)
2311:+
2312:+/-- At a `Z`-block coordinate the source `X` line carries the first
2313:+coordinate. -/
2314:+theorem subLineXIndex_embZ (P : AdmissibleParams) (j : Fin P.m) :
2315:+    subLineXIndex P (embZ P.m j) = subLineFirstIndex P := by
2316:+  have h : ¬ (embZ P.m j).val < P.m := by
2317:+    rw [embZ_val]
2318:+    omega
2319:+  rw [subLineXIndex, dif_neg h]
2320:+
2321:+/-- At the first scalar coordinate the source `X` line carries the first
2322:+coordinate. -/
2323:+theorem subLineXIndex_alphaVar (P : AdmissibleParams) :
2324:+    subLineXIndex P (alphaVar P.m) = subLineFirstIndex P := by
2325:+  have h : ¬ (alphaVar P.m).val < P.m := by
2326:+    rw [alphaVar_val]
2327:+    omega
2328:+  rw [subLineXIndex, dif_neg h]
2329:+
2330:+/-- At the second scalar coordinate the source `X` line carries the first
2331:+coordinate. -/
2332:+theorem subLineXIndex_betaVar (P : AdmissibleParams) :
2333:+    subLineXIndex P (betaVar P.m) = subLineFirstIndex P := by
2334:+  have h : ¬ (betaVar P.m).val < P.m := by
2335:+    rw [betaVar_val]
2336:+    omega
2337:+  rw [subLineXIndex, dif_neg h]
2338:+
2339:+/-- At an `X`-block coordinate the source `Z` line carries the first
2340:+coordinate. -/
2341:+theorem subLineZIndex_embX (P : AdmissibleParams) (i : Fin P.m) :
2342:+    subLineZIndex P (embX P.m i) = subLineFirstIndex P := by
2343:+  have h : ¬ (P.m ≤ (embX P.m i).val ∧ (embX P.m i).val < 2 * P.m) := by
2344:+    rw [embX_val]
2345:+    have := i.isLt
2346:+    omega
2347:+  rw [subLineZIndex, dif_neg h]
2348:+
2349:+/-- At a `Z`-block coordinate the source `Z` line carries that coordinate. -/
2350:+theorem subLineZIndex_embZ (P : AdmissibleParams) (j : Fin P.m) :
2351:+    subLineZIndex P (embZ P.m j) = j := by
2352:+  have hj := j.isLt
2353:+  have h : P.m ≤ (embZ P.m j).val ∧ (embZ P.m j).val < 2 * P.m := by
2354:+    rw [embZ_val]
2355:+    omega
2356:+  rw [subLineZIndex, dif_pos h]
2357:+  refine Fin.ext ?_
2358:+  change (embZ P.m j).val - P.m = j.val
2359:+  rw [embZ_val]
2360:+  omega

2362:+/-- At the first scalar coordinate the source `Z` line carries the first
2363:+coordinate. -/
2364:+theorem subLineZIndex_alphaVar (P : AdmissibleParams) :
2365:+    subLineZIndex P (alphaVar P.m) = subLineFirstIndex P := by
2366:+  have h : ¬ (P.m ≤ (alphaVar P.m).val ∧ (alphaVar P.m).val < 2 * P.m) := by
2367:+    rw [alphaVar_val]
2368:+    omega
2369:+  rw [subLineZIndex, dif_neg h]
2370:+
2371:+/-- At the second scalar coordinate the source `Z` line carries the first
2372:+coordinate. -/
2373:+theorem subLineZIndex_betaVar (P : AdmissibleParams) :
2374:+    subLineZIndex P (betaVar P.m) = subLineFirstIndex P := by
2375:+  have h : ¬ (P.m ≤ (betaVar P.m).val ∧ (betaVar P.m).val < 2 * P.m) := by
2376:+    rw [betaVar_val]
2377:+    omega
2378:+  rw [subLineZIndex, dif_neg h]

2380:+/-! ## The two directions of a branch -/
2381:+
2382:+/-- The direction of the extended line of a branch: the elementary direction
2383:+at the stored coordinate in the axis branch, and the extended direction with
2384:+the coordinates preceding the stored coordinate replaced by zero in the
2385:+diagonal branch.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
2386:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
2387:+def subLineExtDirection (P : AdmissibleParams) (kind : LineKind)
2388:+    (k : Fin (2 * P.m + 2))
2389:+    (w : Fin P.extendedDirectLd.m → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd) :
2390:+    Fin P.extendedDirectLd.m → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd :=
2391:+  match kind with

2393:+  | .diagonal => directPrefixProjection (D := P.extendedDirectLd) k w

2395:+/-- The direction of a source line of a branch: the elementary direction at
2396:+its coordinate index in the axis branch, and the given source block with the

2421:+    cases kind
2422:+  · have hval : projX (directPointToPauli P

2455:+    rw [hval]

2459:+    rw [projX_directPrefixProjection_alphaVar]

2617:+/-!
2618:+# The sampling procedure of the sub-line lemma
2619:+
2620:+This module carries out the sampling procedure of `lem:qld-sublines`.  A line
2621:+kind is drawn from the two kinds, an extended coordinate and an extended point
2622:+and direction are drawn uniformly, and two scalar seeds are drawn
2623:+independently in the coordinate-index fibers of the two coordinates that the
2624:+two source lines must carry.  The sampled triple consists of the axis or
2625:+diagonal line of the extended sample together with the two source lines
2626:+decoded from the two coordinate blocks of the extended point and direction and
2627:+from the two seeds.
2628:+
2629:+The module records the elementary evaluations of that triple, the description
2630:+of the support of the resulting law, the three pointwise properties of a
2631:+sampled triple -- incidence of the two source blocks, compatibility of the
2632:+affine data, and closure of the axis branch -- and the identification of its
2633:+extended-line marginal.
2634:+
2635:+## References
2636:+
2637:+The construction is the proof of `lem:qld-sublines` in
2638:+blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, whose source is
2639:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`.
2640:+The restricted laws are `def:ith-restricted-line`, blueprint lines
2641:+1209--1228, paper lines 1038--1048.
2642:+-/
2643:+
2644:+open scoped BigOperators
2645:+
2646:+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
2647:+
2648:+open MIPStarRE.LDT
2649:+
2650:+noncomputable section
2651:+
2652:+/-! ## The auxiliary randomness of one branch -/
2653:+
2654:+/-- An extended point together with an extended direction.  Blueprint
2655:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
2656:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
2657:+abbrev SubLinePointDir (P : AdmissibleParams) :=
2658:+  (Fin P.extendedDirectLd.m → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd) ×
2659:+    (Fin P.extendedDirectLd.m → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd)
2660:+
2661:+/-- The auxiliary randomness of one branch of the sampling procedure: an
2662:+extended point, an extended direction, and the two scalar seeds of the two
2663:+source lines.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
2664:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
2665:+abbrev SubLineRaw (P : AdmissibleParams) :=
2666:+  SubLinePointDir P × (ScalarQ P.toLdParams × ScalarQ P.toLdParams)
2667:+
2668:+/-- The law of the scalar seed carried by a source line at a given coordinate
2669:+index: uniform on the coordinate-index fiber of that index.  Blueprint
2670:+`def:ith-restricted-line`, paper
2671:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1038-1048`. -/
2672:+noncomputable def subLineSeedDist (P : AdmissibleParams) (i : Fin P.m) :
2673:+    Distribution (ScalarQ P.toLdParams) :=
2674:+  Distribution.restrict (uniformDistribution (ScalarQ P.toLdParams))
2675:+    (ldSeedIndexEvent P.toLdParams i) (ldSeedIndexEvent_positive P.toLdParams i)
2676:+
2677:+/-- Every seed law of a source line has total mass one. -/
2678:+theorem subLineSeedDist_isProbability (P : AdmissibleParams) (i : Fin P.m) :
2679:+    (subLineSeedDist P i).IsProbability := by
2680:+  rw [subLineSeedDist]
2681:+  exact Distribution.restrict_isProbability _ _
2682:+    (ldSeedIndexEvent_positive P.toLdParams i)
2683:+
2684:+/-- The auxiliary randomness law of the sampling procedure: the extended
2685:+coordinate is uniform, the extended point and direction are uniform and
2686:+independent of it, and the two seeds are independent and uniform on the
2687:+coordinate-index fibers of the two coordinates carried by the two source
2688:+lines.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
2689:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
2690:+noncomputable def subLineRawDist (P : AdmissibleParams) :
2691:+    Distribution (Fin (2 * P.m + 2) × SubLineRaw P) :=
2692:+  Distribution.bind (uniformDistribution (Fin (2 * P.m + 2))) fun k =>
2693:+    (Distribution.prod (uniformDistribution (SubLinePointDir P))
2694:+        (Distribution.prod (subLineSeedDist P (subLineXIndex P k))
2695:+          (subLineSeedDist P (subLineZIndex P k)))).map fun w => (k, w)
2696:+
2697:+/-- The auxiliary randomness law has total mass one. -/
2698:+theorem subLineRawDist_isProbability (P : AdmissibleParams) :
2699:+    (subLineRawDist P).IsProbability := by
2700:+  refine Distribution.bind_isProbability _ _
2701:+    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) fun k _ => ?_
2702:+  exact Distribution.IsProbability.map
2703:+    (Distribution.prod_isProbability _ _ (uniformDistribution_isProbability _)
2704:+      (Distribution.prod_isProbability _ _ (subLineSeedDist_isProbability P _)
2705:+        (subLineSeedDist_isProbability P _))) _
2706:+
2707:+/-! ## The sampled triple -/
2708:+
2709:+/-- The extended line of a branch: the canonical axis or diagonal line of an
2710:+extended sample.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
2711:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
2712:+noncomputable def subLineExtLineOfSample (P : AdmissibleParams)
2713:+    (kind : LineKind) (s : DirectLdSpace P.extendedDirectLd) :
2714:+    DirectLineDesc P.extendedDirectLd :=
2715:+  match kind with
2716:+  | .axis => directALineDescOf P.extendedDirectLd s
2717:+  | .diagonal => directDLineDescOf P.extendedDirectLd s
2718:+
2719:+/-- The extended line of a branch, read off the auxiliary randomness.
2720:+Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
2721:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
2722:+noncomputable def subLineExtLine (P : AdmissibleParams) (kind : LineKind)
2723:+    (k : Fin (2 * P.m + 2)) (w : SubLineRaw P) :
2724:+    DirectLineDesc P.extendedDirectLd :=
2725:+  subLineExtLineOfSample P kind ⟨w.1.1, k, w.1.2⟩
2726:+
2727:+/-- A source line of a branch: the canonical axis or diagonal line decoded
2728:+from a point block, a scalar seed and a direction block.  Blueprint
2729:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
2730:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
2731:+noncomputable def subLineSourceLine (P : AdmissibleParams) (kind : LineKind)
2732:+    (b : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (s : ScalarQ P.toLdParams)
2733:+    (d : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) : LineDesc P.toLdParams :=
2734:+  match kind with
2735:+  | .axis => aLineDescOfBlock P.toLdParams (b, (s, d))
2736:+  | .diagonal => dLineDescOfBlock P.toLdParams (b, (s, d))
2737:+
2738:+/-- The triple sampled by one branch of the procedure: the extended line
2739:+together with the two source lines decoded from its two coordinate blocks and
2740:+from the two scalar seeds.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`,
2741:+paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`.
2742:+-/
2743:+noncomputable def subLineTripleOf (P : AdmissibleParams) (kind : LineKind)
2744:+    (k : Fin (2 * P.m + 2)) (w : SubLineRaw P) : SubLineTriple P :=
2745:+  (subLineExtLine P kind k w,
2746:+    (subLineSourceLine P kind (projX (directPointToPauli P w.1.1)) w.2.1
2747:+        (projX (directPointToPauli P w.1.2)),
2748:+      subLineSourceLine P kind (projZ (directPointToPauli P w.1.1)) w.2.2
2749:+        (projZ (directPointToPauli P w.1.2))))
2750:+
2751:+/-- The law of the triples sampled by one branch.  Blueprint
2752:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
2753:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
2754:+noncomputable def subLineBranchDist (P : AdmissibleParams) (kind : LineKind) :
2755:+    Distribution (SubLineTriple P) :=
2756:+  (subLineRawDist P).map fun w => subLineTripleOf P kind w.1 w.2
2757:+
2758:+/-- The sub-line law of `lem:qld-sublines`: the equal mixture of the two
2759:+branches of the sampling procedure.  Blueprint
2760:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
2761:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
2762:+noncomputable def subLineDist (P : AdmissibleParams) :
2763:+    Distribution (SubLineTriple P) :=
2764:+  Distribution.bind (uniformDistribution (Fin 2))
2765:+    ![subLineBranchDist P .axis, subLineBranchDist P .diagonal]
2766:+
2767:+/-! ## Elementary evaluations of the sampled triple -/
2768:+
2769:+/-- The extended line of a branch has the kind of that branch. -/
2770:+theorem subLineExtLine_kind (P : AdmissibleParams) (kind : LineKind)
2771:+    (k : Fin (2 * P.m + 2)) (w : SubLineRaw P) :
2772:+    (subLineExtLine P kind k w).kind = kind := by
2773:+  cases kind <;> rfl
2774:+
2775:+/-- The direction of the extended line of a branch is the branch direction. -/
2776:+theorem subLineExtLine_direction (P : AdmissibleParams) (kind : LineKind)
2777:+    (k : Fin (2 * P.m + 2)) (w : SubLineRaw P) :
2778:+    (subLineExtLine P kind k w).direction =
2779:+      subLineExtDirection P kind k w.1.2 := by
2780:+  cases kind <;> rfl
2781:+
2782:+/-- The base of the extended line of a branch is the canonical representative
2783:+of the drawn point in the branch direction. -/
2784:+theorem subLineExtLine_base (P : AdmissibleParams) (kind : LineKind)
2785:+    (k : Fin (2 * P.m + 2)) (w : SubLineRaw P) :
2786:+    (subLineExtLine P kind k w).base =
2787:+      lineRepMap (subLineExtDirection P kind k w.1.2) w.1.1 := by
2788:+  cases kind <;> rfl
2789:+
2790:+/-- A source line of a branch has the kind of that branch. -/
2791:+theorem subLineSourceLine_kind (P : AdmissibleParams) (kind : LineKind)
2792:+    (b : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (s : ScalarQ P.toLdParams)
2793:+    (d : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
2794:+    (subLineSourceLine P kind b s d).kind = kind := by
2795:+  cases kind <;> rfl
2796:+
2797:+/-- The direction of a source line of a branch is the branch source direction
2798:+at the coordinate index named by its seed. -/
2799:+theorem subLineSourceLine_direction (P : AdmissibleParams) (kind : LineKind)
2800:+    (b : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (s : ScalarQ P.toLdParams)
2801:+    (d : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
2802:+    (subLineSourceLine P kind b s d).direction =
2803:+      subLineSourceDirection P kind (chiIndex P.toLdParams s) d := by
2804:+  cases kind <;> rfl
2805:+
2806:+/-- The base of a source line of a branch is the canonical representative of
2807:+its point block in its own direction. -/
2808:+theorem subLineSourceLine_base (P : AdmissibleParams) (kind : LineKind)
2809:+    (b : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (s : ScalarQ P.toLdParams)
2810:+    (d : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
2811:+    (subLineSourceLine P kind b s d).base =
2812:+      lineRepMap (subLineSourceDirection P kind (chiIndex P.toLdParams s) d)
2813:+        b := by
2814:+  cases kind <;> rfl
2815:+
2816:+/-! ## The support of the sub-line law -/
2817:+
2818:+/-- Every triple in the support of the sub-line law is sampled by one branch
2819:+from auxiliary randomness whose two seeds lie in the coordinate-index fibers
2820:+of the two coordinates carried by the two source lines.  Blueprint
2821:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
2822:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
2823:+theorem exists_raw_of_mem_subLineDist_support (P : AdmissibleParams)
2824:+    {sample : SubLineTriple P} (hsample : sample ∈ (subLineDist P).support) :
2825:+    ∃ (kind : LineKind) (k : Fin (2 * P.m + 2)) (w : SubLineRaw P),
2826:+      chiIndex P.toLdParams w.2.1 = subLineXIndex P k ∧
2827:+        chiIndex P.toLdParams w.2.2 = subLineZIndex P k ∧
2828:+        sample = subLineTripleOf P kind k w := by
2829:+  classical
2830:+  have hbind : sample ∈ (uniformDistribution (Fin 2)).support.biUnion
2831:+      (fun c => (![subLineBranchDist P .axis,
2832:+        subLineBranchDist P .diagonal] c).support) := hsample
2833:+  obtain ⟨c, -, hc⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hbind
2834:+  obtain ⟨kind, hkind⟩ : ∃ kind : LineKind,
2835:+      sample ∈ (subLineBranchDist P kind).support := by
2836:+    fin_cases c
2837:+    · exact ⟨.axis, by simpa using hc⟩
2838:+    · exact ⟨.diagonal, by simpa using hc⟩
2839:+  obtain ⟨kw, hkw, hkw'⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hkind
2840:+  obtain ⟨k, -, hk⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp
2841:+    (show kw ∈ (uniformDistribution (Fin (2 * P.m + 2))).support.biUnion
2842:+      (fun k => ((Distribution.prod (uniformDistribution (SubLinePointDir P))
2843:+        (Distribution.prod (subLineSeedDist P (subLineXIndex P k))
2844:+          (subLineSeedDist P (subLineZIndex P k)))).map
2845:+        (fun w => (k, w))).support) from hkw)
2846:+  obtain ⟨w, hw, hw'⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hk
2847:+  obtain ⟨-, hseeds⟩ := Finset.mem_product.mp hw
2848:+  obtain ⟨hsx, hsz⟩ := Finset.mem_product.mp hseeds
2849:+  have hx : chiIndex P.toLdParams w.2.1 = subLineXIndex P k :=
2850:+    (Finset.mem_filter.mp hsx).2
2851:+  have hz : chiIndex P.toLdParams w.2.2 = subLineZIndex P k :=
2852:+    (Finset.mem_filter.mp hsz).2
2853:+  refine ⟨kind, k, w, hx, hz, ?_⟩
2854:+  rw [← hkw', ← hw']
2855:+
2856:+/-! ## Pointwise properties of a sampled triple -/
2857:+
2858:+/-- The direction of the source `X` line of a sampled triple is the branch
2859:+source direction at the coordinate carried by that line. -/
2860:+theorem subLineTripleOf_xDirection (P : AdmissibleParams) (kind : LineKind)
2861:+    (k : Fin (2 * P.m + 2)) (w : SubLineRaw P)
2862:+    (hx : chiIndex P.toLdParams w.2.1 = subLineXIndex P k) :
2863:+    (subLineTripleOf P kind k w).2.1.direction =
2864:+      subLineSourceDirection P kind (subLineXIndex P k)
2865:+        (projX (directPointToPauli P w.1.2)) := by
2866:+  have h : (subLineTripleOf P kind k w).2.1.direction =
2867:+      subLineSourceDirection P kind (chiIndex P.toLdParams w.2.1)
2868:+        (projX (directPointToPauli P w.1.2)) :=
2869:+    subLineSourceLine_direction P kind _ w.2.1 _
2870:+  rw [h, hx]
2871:+
2872:+/-- The direction of the source `Z` line of a sampled triple is the branch
2873:+source direction at the coordinate carried by that line. -/
2874:+theorem subLineTripleOf_zDirection (P : AdmissibleParams) (kind : LineKind)
2875:+    (k : Fin (2 * P.m + 2)) (w : SubLineRaw P)
2876:+    (hz : chiIndex P.toLdParams w.2.2 = subLineZIndex P k) :
2877:+    (subLineTripleOf P kind k w).2.2.direction =
2878:+      subLineSourceDirection P kind (subLineZIndex P k)
2879:+        (projZ (directPointToPauli P w.1.2)) := by
2880:+  have h : (subLineTripleOf P kind k w).2.2.direction =
2881:+      subLineSourceDirection P kind (chiIndex P.toLdParams w.2.2)
2882:+        (projZ (directPointToPauli P w.1.2)) :=
2883:+    subLineSourceLine_direction P kind _ w.2.2 _

3177:+/-!
3178:+# Coordinate blocks of an extended point and of an extended direct sample
3179:+
3180:+This module records the block decomposition used by the sampling procedure of
3181:+the sub-line lemma on the extended dimension.  A point of the extended space
3182:+is the tuple consisting of its two source point blocks and its two scalar
3183:+coordinates, and this decomposition is a bijection carrying the uniform law to
3184:+the uniform law; in particular the two source blocks of a uniform extended
3185:+point are independent and uniform.  The decomposition is linear, so it
3186:+commutes with the affine parameterization of a line, and it commutes with the
3187:+canonical identification of the extended scalar field with the source scalar
3188:+field.  The stored coordinate index of an extended direct sample splits along
3189:+the same three coordinate ranges.
3190:+
3191:+## References
3192:+
3193:+The decompositions support `lem:qld-sublines` in
3194:+blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, whose source is
3195:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`.
3196:+The coordinate blocks are those of `def:combine-map`, blueprint lines
3197:+445--480, paper lines 970--989.
3198:+-/

3208:+/-! ## Linearity of the coordinate blocks -/

3210:+/-- The `X` block of a sum of extended points is the sum of the blocks.

3213:+theorem projX_add {K : Type*} [AddCommMonoid K] {m : ℕ}
3214:+    (u v : Fin (2 * m + 2) → K) :
3215:+    projX (u + v) = projX u + projX v := rfl
3216:+
3217:+/-- The `Z` block of a sum of extended points is the sum of the blocks.
3218:+Blueprint `def:combine-map`, paper
3219:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:970-989`. -/
3220:+theorem projZ_add {K : Type*} [AddCommMonoid K] {m : ℕ}
3221:+    (u v : Fin (2 * m + 2) → K) :
3222:+    projZ (u + v) = projZ u + projZ v := rfl

3224:+/-- The `X` block of a scalar multiple of an extended point is the scalar

3227:+theorem projX_smul {K : Type*} [Monoid K] {m : ℕ} (t : K)
3228:+    (u : Fin (2 * m + 2) → K) :

3236:+    projZ (t • u) = t • projZ u := rfl

3243:+def extendedPointBlockEquiv (P : AdmissibleParams) :
3244:+    (Fin (2 * P.m + 2) → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd) ≃
3245:+      ((Fin P.m → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd) ×
3246:+          (Fin P.m → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd)) ×
3247:+        (Fin 2 → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd) :=
3248:+  (Equiv.arrowCongr (finCombineEquiv P.m)
3249:+      (Equiv.refl (DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd))).trans
3250:+    ((Equiv.sumArrowEquivProdArrow _ _ _).trans
3251:+      (Equiv.prodCongr (Equiv.sumArrowEquivProdArrow _ _ _) (Equiv.refl _)))
3252:+
3253:+/-- The first block of the decomposition is the `X` block. -/
3254:+theorem extendedPointBlockEquiv_projX (P : AdmissibleParams)
3255:+    (u : Fin (2 * P.m + 2) → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd) :
3256:+    (extendedPointBlockEquiv P u).1.1 = projX u := by
3257:+  funext i
3258:+  rfl
3259:+
3260:+/-- The second block of the decomposition is the `Z` block. -/
3261:+theorem extendedPointBlockEquiv_projZ (P : AdmissibleParams)
3262:+    (u : Fin (2 * P.m + 2) → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd) :
3263:+    (extendedPointBlockEquiv P u).1.2 = projZ u := by
3264:+  funext i
3265:+  rfl
3266:+
3267:+/-- The first scalar coordinate of the decomposition is `alpha`. -/
3268:+theorem extendedPointBlockEquiv_alpha (P : AdmissibleParams)
3269:+    (u : Fin (2 * P.m + 2) → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd) :
3270:+    (extendedPointBlockEquiv P u).2 0 = u (alphaVar P.m) := rfl
3271:+
3272:+/-- The second scalar coordinate of the decomposition is `beta`. -/
3273:+theorem extendedPointBlockEquiv_beta (P : AdmissibleParams)
3274:+    (u : Fin (2 * P.m + 2) → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd) :
3275:+    (extendedPointBlockEquiv P u).2 1 = u (betaVar P.m) := rfl
3276:+
3277:+/-- The block decomposition of an extended point carries the uniform law to
3278:+the uniform law.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
3279:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
3280:+theorem uniformDistribution_map_extendedPointBlockEquiv (P : AdmissibleParams) :
3281:+    (uniformDistribution
3282:+          (Fin (2 * P.m + 2) → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd)).map
3283:+        (extendedPointBlockEquiv P) =
3284:+      uniformDistribution
3285:+        (((Fin P.m → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd) ×
3286:+            (Fin P.m → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd)) ×
3287:+          (Fin 2 → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd)) :=
3288:+  uniformDistribution_map_equiv _
3289:+
3290:+/-- The two source blocks of a uniformly sampled extended point are
3291:+independent and uniform.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
3292:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
3293:+theorem uniformDistribution_map_projX_projZ (P : AdmissibleParams) :
3294:+    (uniformDistribution
3295:+          (Fin (2 * P.m + 2) → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd)).map
3296:+        (fun u => (projX u, projZ u)) =
3297:+      Distribution.prod
3298:+        (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd))
3299:+        (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd)) := by
3300:+  have hfun :
3301:+      (fun u : Fin (2 * P.m + 2) → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd =>
3302:+          (projX u, projZ u)) =
3303:+        fun u => (extendedPointBlockEquiv P u).1 := by
3304:+    funext u
3305:+    rw [Prod.ext_iff]
3306:+    exact ⟨(extendedPointBlockEquiv_projX P u).symm,
3307:+      (extendedPointBlockEquiv_projZ P u).symm⟩
3308:+  rw [hfun, ← Distribution.map_map _ (extendedPointBlockEquiv P) Prod.fst,
3309:+    uniformDistribution_map_extendedPointBlockEquiv,
3310:+    uniformDistribution_map_fst, uniformDistribution_prod]
3311:+
3312:+/-! ## Transport to the source scalar field -/
3313:+
3314:+/-- The `X` block of an extended point transported to the source scalar field
3315:+is the transport of its `X` block.  Blueprint
3316:+`def:combine-map`, paper
3317:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:970-989`. -/
3318:+theorem projX_directPointToPauli (P : AdmissibleParams)
3319:+    (u : Fin P.extendedDirectLd.m → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd) :
3320:+    projX (directPointToPauli P u) =
3321:+      fun i => extendedDirectScalarEquiv P (projX u i) := rfl
3322:+
3323:+/-- The `Z` block of an extended point transported to the source scalar field
3324:+is the transport of its `Z` block.  Blueprint
3325:+`def:combine-map`, paper
3326:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:970-989`. -/
3327:+theorem projZ_directPointToPauli (P : AdmissibleParams)
3328:+    (u : Fin P.extendedDirectLd.m → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd) :
3329:+    projZ (directPointToPauli P u) =
3330:+      fun i => extendedDirectScalarEquiv P (projZ u i) := rfl
3331:+
3332:+/-! ## The blocks of an extended direct sample -/
3333:+
3334:+/-- The stored index, point block and direction block of a uniformly sampled
3335:+direct low-degree vector are independent and uniform.  Blueprint
3336:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
3337:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
3338:+theorem uniformDistribution_map_directLdSpaceIndexEquiv (D : DirectLdParams) :
3339:+    (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace D)).map (directLdSpaceIndexEquiv D) =
3340:+      uniformDistribution
3341:+        (Fin D.m ×
3342:+          ((Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))) :=
3343:+  uniformDistribution_map_equiv _
3344:+
3345:+/-! ## Compatibility data read off the coordinate blocks -/
3346:+
3347:+/-- An extended line is compatible with two source lines as soon as each of
3348:+its two point blocks is an affine reparameterization of the corresponding
3349:+source line: the base block is a point of the source line and the direction
3350:+block is a multiple of the source direction.  The two scalar coordinates of
3351:+the compatibility data are the `alpha` and `beta` coordinates of the extended
3352:+base and direction.  This supplies the domain condition preceding Equation
3353:+`eq:combine-lines` in blueprint
3354:+`def:combine-map`, paper
3355:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:970-989`. -/
3356:+theorem isCombineLineCompatible_of_blocks {K : Type*} [Field K] {m : ℕ}
3357:+    (u v : Fin (2 * m + 2) → K) (uX vX uZ vZ : Fin m → K) (aX bX aZ bZ : K)
3358:+    (hX : projX u = uX + aX • vX) (hXv : projX v = bX • vX)
3359:+    (hZ : projZ u = uZ + aZ • vZ) (hZv : projZ v = bZ • vZ) :
3360:+    IsCombineLineCompatible u v uX vX uZ vZ aX bX aZ bZ
3361:+      (u (alphaVar m)) (v (alphaVar m)) (u (betaVar m)) (v (betaVar m)) := by
3362:+  refine ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, fun t => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
3363:+  · rw [projX_add, projX_smul, hX, hXv]
3364:+    module
3365:+  · rw [projZ_add, projZ_smul, hZ, hZv]
3366:+    module
3367:+
3368:+/-- An extended line whose two source lines carry the inherited direction
3369:+blocks is compatible with them, with both affine reparameterizations the
3370:+identity.  Blueprint `def:combine-map`, paper
3371:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:970-989`. -/
3372:+theorem isCombineLineCompatible_inherited {K : Type*} [Field K] {m : ℕ}
3373:+    (u v : Fin (2 * m + 2) → K) :
3374:+    IsCombineLineCompatible u v (projX u) (projX v) (projZ u) (projZ v)
3375:+      0 1 0 1 (u (alphaVar m)) (v (alphaVar m)) (u (betaVar m))
3376:+      (v (betaVar m)) :=
3377:+  isCombineLineCompatible_of_blocks u v _ _ _ _ 0 1 0 1
3378:+    (by module) (by module) (by module) (by module)
3379:+
3380:+end
3381:+
3382:+end MIPStarRE.QPBT

3389:+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.Lines.SubLineSource
3390:+
3391:+/-!
3392:+# The projected mixtures of the sub-line law
3393:+
3394:+This module assembles the two projected point marginals of the sub-line law of
3395:+`lem:qld-sublines` into mixtures of the restricted product laws.  Drawing a
3396:+uniform point of the extended line of a mixture of line laws is the same
3397:+mixture of the corresponding uniform-point laws, so the two projected
3398:+marginals of the sub-line law are the mixtures, over the drawn kind and the
3399:+drawn extended coordinate, of the projected marginals of one branch at one
3400:+extended coordinate.  Each of those is the component law of the pair of
3401:+indices carried by that branch, so the mixing law is the law of the kind
3402:+together with the pair of indices assigned to a uniform extended coordinate.
3403:+
3404:+## References
3405:+
3406:+The assembly is the last step of the proof of `lem:qld-sublines` in
3407:+blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, whose source is
3408:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`.
3409:+The restricted laws are `def:ith-restricted-line`, blueprint lines
3410:+1209--1228, paper lines 1038--1048.
3411:+-/
3412:+
3413:+open scoped BigOperators
3414:+
3415:+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
3416:+
3417:+open MIPStarRE.LDT
3418:+
3419:+noncomputable section
3420:+
3421:+/-! ## The uniform point of a mixture of line laws -/
3422:+
3423:+/-- Drawing a uniform point of the extended line of a mixture of line-triple
3424:+laws is the corresponding mixture of the uniform-point laws.  Blueprint
3425:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
3426:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
3427:+theorem subLinePointDist_bind (P : AdmissibleParams) {α : Type*}
3428:+    (μ : Distribution α) (ν : α → Distribution (SubLineTriple P)) :
3429:+    subLinePointDist P (Distribution.bind μ ν) =
3430:+      Distribution.bind μ (fun a => subLinePointDist P (ν a)) := by
3431:+  classical
3432:+  unfold subLinePointDist
3433:+  rw [Distribution.prod_bind_left, Distribution.bind_map]
3434:+
3435:+/-! ## The projected marginals of one branch at one extended coordinate -/
3436:+
3437:+/-- One branch of the sampling procedure, read at a fixed extended coordinate,
3438:+is the law of the triple decoded from the auxiliary randomness of that
3439:+coordinate.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
3440:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
3441:+theorem subLineBranchDist_eq_bind (P : AdmissibleParams) (kind : LineKind) :
3442:+    subLineBranchDist P kind =
3443:+      Distribution.bind (uniformDistribution (Fin (2 * P.m + 2))) fun k =>
3444:+        (Distribution.prod (uniformDistribution (SubLinePointDir P))
3445:+            (Distribution.prod (subLineSeedDist P (subLineXIndex P k))
3446:+              (subLineSeedDist P (subLineZIndex P k)))).map
3447:+          fun w => subLineTripleOf P kind k w := by
3448:+  classical
3449:+  rw [subLineBranchDist, subLineRawDist, Distribution.bind_map]
3450:+  refine Distribution.bind_congr_support _ _ _ fun k _ => ?_
3451:+  rw [Distribution.map_map]
3452:+
3453:+/-- The `X` marginal of a uniform point of the extended line of one branch at
3454:+one extended coordinate is the `X` component law of the pair of indices of
3455:+that branch.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
3456:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
3457:+theorem subLineBranchDist_map_subLineXProjection_at (P : AdmissibleParams)
3458:+    (kind : LineKind) (k : Fin (2 * P.m + 2)) :
3459:+    (subLinePointDist P
3460:+        ((Distribution.prod (uniformDistribution (SubLinePointDir P))
3461:+            (Distribution.prod (subLineSeedDist P (subLineXIndex P k))
3462:+              (subLineSeedDist P (subLineZIndex P k)))).map
3463:+          fun w => subLineTripleOf P kind k w)).map subLineXProjection =
3464:+      subLineXComponentDist P
3465:+        (kind, (subLineXIndex P k, subLineZIndex P k)) := by
3466:+  classical
3467:+  unfold subLinePointDist
3468:+  rw [Distribution.prod_map_left, Distribution.map_map, Distribution.map_map]
3469:+  exact subLineBranchRaw_map_projX P kind k
3470:+
3471:+/-- The `Z` marginal of a uniform point of the extended line of one branch at
3472:+one extended coordinate is the `Z` component law of the pair of indices of
3473:+that branch.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
3474:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
3475:+theorem subLineBranchDist_map_subLineZProjection_at (P : AdmissibleParams)
3476:+    (kind : LineKind) (k : Fin (2 * P.m + 2)) :
3477:+    (subLinePointDist P
3478:+        ((Distribution.prod (uniformDistribution (SubLinePointDir P))
3479:+            (Distribution.prod (subLineSeedDist P (subLineXIndex P k))
3480:+              (subLineSeedDist P (subLineZIndex P k)))).map
3481:+          fun w => subLineTripleOf P kind k w)).map subLineZProjection =
3482:+      subLineZComponentDist P
3483:+        (kind, (subLineXIndex P k, subLineZIndex P k)) := by
3484:+  classical
3485:+  unfold subLinePointDist
3486:+  rw [Distribution.prod_map_left, Distribution.map_map, Distribution.map_map]
3487:+  exact subLineBranchRaw_map_projZ P kind k
3488:+
3489:+/-! ## The mixing law of the two indices -/
3490:+
3491:+/-- The law of the kind and the pair of source indices assigned to a uniform
3492:+extended coordinate of one branch.  Blueprint
3493:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
3494:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
3495:+noncomputable def subLineComponentBranch (P : AdmissibleParams)
3496:+    (kind : LineKind) : Distribution (SubLineComponent P) :=
3497:+  (uniformDistribution (Fin (2 * P.m + 2))).map fun k =>
3498:+    (kind, (subLineXIndex P k, subLineZIndex P k))
3499:+
3500:+/-- The mixing law of the sub-line lemma: the equal mixture over the two kinds
3501:+of the law of the pair of source indices of a uniform extended coordinate.
3502:+Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
3503:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
3504:+noncomputable def subLineComponentDist (P : AdmissibleParams) :
3505:+    Distribution (SubLineComponent P) :=
3506:+  Distribution.bind (uniformDistribution (Fin 2))
3507:+    ![subLineComponentBranch P .axis, subLineComponentBranch P .diagonal]
3508:+
3509:+/-- The mixing law has total mass one. -/
3510:+theorem subLineComponentDist_isProbability (P : AdmissibleParams) :
3511:+    (subLineComponentDist P).IsProbability := by
3512:+  refine Distribution.bind_isProbability _ _
3513:+    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) fun c _ => ?_
3514:+  fin_cases c
3515:+  · exact Distribution.IsProbability.map
3516:+      (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) _
3517:+  · exact Distribution.IsProbability.map
3518:+      (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) _
3519:+
3520:+/-! ## The two projected marginals of one branch -/
3521:+
3522:+/-- The `X` marginal of a uniform point of the extended line of one branch is
3523:+the mixture, along the pair of source indices of a uniform extended
3524:+coordinate, of the `X` component laws.  Blueprint
3525:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
3526:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
3527:+theorem subLineBranchDist_map_subLineXProjection (P : AdmissibleParams)
3528:+    (kind : LineKind) :
3529:+    (subLinePointDist P (subLineBranchDist P kind)).map subLineXProjection =
3530:+      Distribution.bind (subLineComponentBranch P kind)
3531:+        (subLineXComponentDist P) := by
3532:+  classical
3533:+  rw [subLineBranchDist_eq_bind, subLinePointDist_bind, Distribution.bind_map,
3534:+    subLineComponentBranch, Distribution.bind_map_left]
3535:+  refine Distribution.bind_congr_support _ _ _ fun k _ => ?_
3536:+  exact subLineBranchDist_map_subLineXProjection_at P kind k
3537:+
3538:+/-- The `Z` marginal of a uniform point of the extended line of one branch is
3539:+the mixture, along the pair of source indices of a uniform extended
3540:+coordinate, of the `Z` component laws.  Blueprint
3541:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
3542:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
3543:+theorem subLineBranchDist_map_subLineZProjection (P : AdmissibleParams)
3544:+    (kind : LineKind) :
3545:+    (subLinePointDist P (subLineBranchDist P kind)).map subLineZProjection =
3546:+      Distribution.bind (subLineComponentBranch P kind)
3547:+        (subLineZComponentDist P) := by
3548:+  classical
3549:+  rw [subLineBranchDist_eq_bind, subLinePointDist_bind, Distribution.bind_map,
3550:+    subLineComponentBranch, Distribution.bind_map_left]
3551:+  refine Distribution.bind_congr_support _ _ _ fun k _ => ?_
3552:+  exact subLineBranchDist_map_subLineZProjection_at P kind k
3553:+
3554:+/-! ## The two projected marginals of the sub-line law -/
3555:+
3556:+/-- The `X` point marginal of the sub-line law is the mixture of the `X`
3557:+component laws along the mixing law.  Blueprint
3558:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
3559:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
3560:+theorem subLineDist_map_subLineXProjection (P : AdmissibleParams) :
3561:+    (subLinePointDist P (subLineDist P)).map subLineXProjection =
3562:+      Distribution.bind (subLineComponentDist P) (subLineXComponentDist P) := by
3563:+  classical
3564:+  rw [subLineDist, subLinePointDist_bind, Distribution.bind_map,
3565:+    subLineComponentDist, Distribution.bind_bind]
3566:+  refine Distribution.bind_congr_support _ _ _ fun c _ => ?_
3567:+  fin_cases c
3568:+  · exact subLineBranchDist_map_subLineXProjection P .axis
3569:+  · exact subLineBranchDist_map_subLineXProjection P .diagonal
3570:+
3571:+/-- The `Z` point marginal of the sub-line law is the mixture of the `Z`
3572:+component laws along the mixing law.  Blueprint
3573:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
3574:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
3575:+theorem subLineDist_map_subLineZProjection (P : AdmissibleParams) :
3576:+    (subLinePointDist P (subLineDist P)).map subLineZProjection =
3577:+      Distribution.bind (subLineComponentDist P) (subLineZComponentDist P) := by
3578:+  classical
3579:+  rw [subLineDist, subLinePointDist_bind, Distribution.bind_map,
3580:+    subLineComponentDist, Distribution.bind_bind]
3581:+  refine Distribution.bind_congr_support _ _ _ fun c _ => ?_
3582:+  fin_cases c
3583:+  · exact subLineBranchDist_map_subLineZProjection P .axis
3584:+  · exact subLineBranchDist_map_subLineZProjection P .diagonal
3585:+
3586:+/-- The two one-point projected marginals of the sub-line law are mixtures of
3587:+the restricted product laws along one common mixing law.  Blueprint
3588:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
3589:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
3590:+theorem subLineDist_source_mixture (P : AdmissibleParams) :
3591:+    ∃ components : Distribution (SubLineComponent P),
3592:+      components.IsProbability ∧
3593:+        (subLinePointDist P (subLineDist P)).map subLineXProjection =
3594:+          Distribution.bind components (subLineXComponentDist P) ∧
3595:+        (subLinePointDist P (subLineDist P)).map subLineZProjection =
3596:+          Distribution.bind components (subLineZComponentDist P) :=
3597:+  ⟨subLineComponentDist P, subLineComponentDist_isProbability P,
3598:+    subLineDist_map_subLineXProjection P,
3599:+    subLineDist_map_subLineZProjection P⟩
3600:+
3601:+end
3602:+
3603:+end MIPStarRE.QPBT

3610:+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.Lines.SubLineUniform
3611:+
3612:+/-!
3613:+# Coordinate blocks of a truncated extended direction
3614:+
3615:+This module computes the two source blocks of the direction of an extended
3616:+diagonal line.  That direction is obtained from an unrestricted extended
3617:+vector by zeroing the coordinates that precede the stored coordinate index,
3618:+so each source block is again a prefix truncation: when the stored index is
3619:+the `i`-th coordinate of a block, that block inherits the truncation at `i`,
3620:+preceding blocks vanish, and later blocks remain untruncated.
3621:+The computation is recorded after transport to the source scalar field, since
3622:+the extended direction and the source line directions are presented over the
3623:+two identified scalar fields.
3624:+
3625:+## References
3626:+
3627:+The block computations support `lem:qld-sublines` in
3628:+blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, whose source is
3629:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`.
3630:+The truncation is the prefix restriction of blueprint
3631:+`def:ld-question-distribution`; the coordinate blocks are those of
3632:+blueprint `def:combine-map`.
3633:+-/
3634:+
3635:+open scoped BigOperators
3636:+
3637:+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
3638:+
3639:+open MIPStarRE.LDT
3640:+
3641:+noncomputable section
3642:+
3643:+/-! ## Truncation at the first coordinate -/
3644:+
3645:+/-- Zeroing the coordinates preceding the first coordinate changes nothing.
3646:+Blueprint `def:ld-question-distribution`, paper
3647:+`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
3648:+-/
3649:+theorem prefixProjection_of_val_zero {L : LdParams} {i : Fin L.m}
3650:+    (hi : i.val = 0) (v : Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) :
3651:+    prefixProjection i v = v := by
3652:+  funext j
3653:+  simp [prefixProjection, hi]
3654:+
3655:+/-! ## The `X` block of a truncated extended direction -/
3656:+
3657:+/-- The `X` block of an extended direction truncated at an `X`-block
3658:+coordinate is the `X` block truncated at that coordinate of the source space.
