3791:+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.Lines.SubLineBind
3792:+
3793:+/-!
3794:+# Products and push-forwards of finite distributions
3795:+
3796:+The sampling procedure of the sub-line lemma presents one law both as an
3797:+independent product of its generating blocks and as a dependent mixture over
3798:+one of those blocks.  This module records the three rewriting rules that pass
3799:+between the two presentations: a push-forward of the first factor of a product
3800:+is a push-forward of the product, a product with a probability law in the
3801:+second factor has the first factor as its marginal, and a push-forward of a
3802:+product is the dependent mixture of the push-forwards of its second factor.
3803:+
3804:+## References
3805:+
3806:+The rewriting rules support `lem:qld-sublines` in
3807:+blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, whose source is
3808:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`.
3809:+The product and mixture operations are those of blueprint
3810:+`def:line-point-dist`.
3811:+-/
3812:+
3813:+open scoped BigOperators
3814:+
3815:+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
3816:+
3817:+open MIPStarRE.LDT
3818:+
3819:+noncomputable section
3820:+
3821:+/-! ## Nonemptiness of the support of a probability law -/
3822:+
3823:+/-- A law of total mass one has a nonempty support.  Blueprint
3824:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
3825:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
3826:+theorem Distribution.support_nonempty_of_isProbability {α : Type*}
3827:+    {μ : Distribution α} (hμ : μ.IsProbability) : μ.support.Nonempty := by
3828:+  rw [← Finset.card_pos]
3829:+  by_contra hcard
3830:+  have hempty : μ.support = ∅ := by
3831:+    rw [← Finset.card_eq_zero]
3832:+    omega
3833:+  have h1 := hμ.weight_sum_eq_one
3834:+  rw [hempty] at h1
3835:+  simp at h1
3836:+
3837:+/-! ## Push-forward of one factor of a product -/
3838:+
3839:+/-- Pushing the first factor of a product forward is pushing the product
3840:+forward along the map acting on that factor alone.  Blueprint
3841:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
3842:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
3843:+theorem Distribution.prod_map_left {α β γ : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
3844:+    [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ] (μ : Distribution α) (ν : Distribution β)
3845:+    (f : α → γ) :
3846:+    Distribution.prod (μ.map f) ν =
3847:+      (Distribution.prod μ ν).map (fun w => (f w.1, w.2)) := by
3848:+  classical
3849:+  refine Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight ?_ ?_
3850:+  · change (μ.support.image f) ×ˢ ν.support =
3851:+      (μ.support ×ˢ ν.support).image (fun w => (f w.1, w.2))
3852:+    ext w
3853:+    obtain ⟨c, y⟩ := w
3854:+    simp only [Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_image, Prod.mk.injEq, Prod.exists]
3855:+    constructor
3856:+    · rintro ⟨⟨a, ha, rfl⟩, hy⟩
3857:+      exact ⟨a, y, ⟨ha, hy⟩, rfl, rfl⟩
3858:+    · rintro ⟨a, b, ⟨ha, hb⟩, rfl, rfl⟩
3859:+      exact ⟨⟨a, ha, rfl⟩, hb⟩
3860:+  · funext w
3861:+    obtain ⟨c, y⟩ := w
3862:+    have hfilter :
3863:+        (μ.support ×ˢ ν.support).filter (fun p => (f p.1, p.2) = (c, y)) =
3864:+          (μ.support.filter (fun a => f a = c)) ×ˢ
3865:+            (ν.support.filter (fun b => b = y)) := by
3866:+      ext p
3867:+      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Prod.mk.injEq]
3868:+      tauto
3869:+    have hy : ∑ b ∈ ν.support.filter (fun b => b = y), ν.weight b =
3870:+        ν.weight y := by
3871:+      rw [Finset.filter_eq' ν.support y]
3872:+      by_cases hmem : y ∈ ν.support
3873:+      · rw [if_pos hmem, Finset.sum_singleton]
3874:+      · rw [if_neg hmem, Finset.sum_empty, ν.outsideSupport y hmem]
3875:+    change (μ.map f).weight c * ν.weight y =
3876:+      ∑ p ∈ (μ.support ×ˢ ν.support).filter (fun p => (f p.1, p.2) = (c, y)),
3877:+        μ.weight p.1 * ν.weight p.2
3878:+    rw [hfilter, Finset.sum_product,
3879:+      Finset.sum_congr rfl
3880:+        (fun a _ => (Finset.mul_sum (ν.support.filter (fun b => b = y))
3881:+          (fun b => ν.weight b) (μ.weight a)).symm),
3882:+      hy, ← Finset.sum_mul]
3883:+    rfl
3884:+
3885:+/-! ## The first marginal of a product -/
3886:+
3887:+/-- The first marginal of a product whose second factor is a probability law
3888:+is the first factor.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
3889:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
3890:+theorem Distribution.prod_map_fst {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
3891:+    (μ : Distribution α) (ν : Distribution β) (hν : ν.IsProbability) :
3892:+    (Distribution.prod μ ν).map Prod.fst = μ := by
3893:+  classical
3894:+  obtain ⟨b₀, hb₀⟩ := Distribution.support_nonempty_of_isProbability hν
3895:+  refine Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight ?_ ?_
3896:+  · change (μ.support ×ˢ ν.support).image Prod.fst = μ.support
3897:+    ext a
3898:+    simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_product, Prod.exists]
3899:+    constructor
3900:+    · rintro ⟨x, y, ⟨hx, -⟩, rfl⟩
3901:+      exact hx
3902:+    · intro ha
3903:+      exact ⟨a, b₀, ⟨ha, hb₀⟩, rfl⟩
3904:+  · funext a
3905:+    have hfilter : (μ.support ×ˢ ν.support).filter (fun p => p.1 = a) =
3906:+        (μ.support.filter (fun x => x = a)) ×ˢ ν.support := by
3907:+      ext p
3908:+      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product]
3909:+      tauto
3910:+    have ha : ∑ x ∈ μ.support.filter (fun x => x = a), μ.weight x =
3911:+        μ.weight a := by
3912:+      rw [Finset.filter_eq' μ.support a]
3913:+      by_cases hmem : a ∈ μ.support
3914:+      · rw [if_pos hmem, Finset.sum_singleton]
3915:+      · rw [if_neg hmem, Finset.sum_empty, μ.outsideSupport a hmem]
3916:+    change (∑ p ∈ (μ.support ×ˢ ν.support).filter (fun p => p.1 = a),
3917:+      μ.weight p.1 * ν.weight p.2) = μ.weight a
3918:+    rw [hfilter, Finset.sum_product,
3919:+      Finset.sum_congr rfl
3920:+        (fun x _ => (Finset.mul_sum ν.support (fun b => ν.weight b)
3921:+          (μ.weight x)).symm),
3922:+      hν.weight_sum_eq_one]
3923:+    simpa using ha
3924:+
3925:+/-- Reading a function of the first factor of a product whose second factor is
3926:+a probability law is reading it on the first factor.  Blueprint
3927:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
3928:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
3929:+theorem Distribution.prod_map_of_fst {α β γ : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
3930:+    [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ] (μ : Distribution α) (ν : Distribution β)
3931:+    (hν : ν.IsProbability) (h : α → γ) :
3932:+    (Distribution.prod μ ν).map (fun w => h w.1) = μ.map h := by
3933:+  rw [← Distribution.map_map (Distribution.prod μ ν) Prod.fst h,
3934:+    Distribution.prod_map_fst μ ν hν]
3935:+
3936:+/-! ## A product as a dependent mixture -/
3937:+
3938:+/-- A push-forward of a product is the dependent mixture, over the first
3939:+factor, of the push-forwards of the second factor.  Blueprint
3940:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
3941:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
3942:+theorem Distribution.prod_map_eq_bind {α β γ : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
3943:+    [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ] (μ : Distribution α) (ν : Distribution β)
3944:+    (g : α × β → γ) :
3945:+    (Distribution.prod μ ν).map g =
3946:+      Distribution.bind μ (fun a => ν.map (fun b => g (a, b))) := by
3947:+  classical
3948:+  refine Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight ?_ ?_
3949:+  · change (μ.support ×ˢ ν.support).image g =
3950:+      μ.support.biUnion (fun a => ν.support.image (fun b => g (a, b)))
3951:+    ext c
3952:+    simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_product,
3953:+      Prod.exists]
3954:+    constructor
3955:+    · rintro ⟨a, b, ⟨ha, hb⟩, rfl⟩
3956:+      exact ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩
3957:+    · rintro ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩
3958:+      exact ⟨a, b, ⟨ha, hb⟩, rfl⟩
3959:+  · funext c
3960:+    change (∑ p ∈ (μ.support ×ˢ ν.support).filter (fun p => g p = c),
3961:+        μ.weight p.1 * ν.weight p.2) =
3962:+      ∑ a ∈ μ.support, μ.weight a *
3963:+        ∑ b ∈ ν.support.filter (fun b => g (a, b) = c), ν.weight b
3964:+    rw [Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_product]
3965:+    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
3966:+    rw [Finset.sum_filter, Finset.mul_sum]
3967:+    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
3968:+    by_cases h : g (a, b) = c
3969:+    · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h]
3970:+    · rw [if_neg h, if_neg h, mul_zero]
3971:+
3972:+end
3973:+
3974:+end MIPStarRE.QPBT

3983:+/-!
3984:+# The two independent blocks of a fresh diagonal direction pair
3985:+
3986:+This module splits the fresh diagonal direction pair of the sub-line sampling
3987:+procedure into its two independent blocks.  The coordinate-index event
3988:+constrains only the scalar seed of the pair, so conditioning on it leaves the
3989:+direction block uniform and independent of the conditioned seed.  The
3990:+direction block of a fresh pair is therefore available as an unconstrained
3991:+uniform vector, which is what allows the sampling procedure to read it off the
3992:+corresponding block of the direction of the sampled extended line.
3993:+
3994:+## References
3995:+
3996:+The block decomposition supports `lem:qld-sublines` in
3997:+blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, whose source is
3998:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`.
3999:+The coordinate-index event is that of `def:ith-restricted-line`, blueprint
4000:+lines 1209--1228, paper lines 1038--1048.
4001:+-/
4002:+
4003:+open scoped BigOperators
4004:+
4005:+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
4006:+
4007:+open MIPStarRE.LDT
4008:+
4009:+noncomputable section
4010:+
4011:+/-! ## Conditioning the first factor of a product -/
4012:+
4013:+/-- Restricting a product law to an event depending on the first factor alone
4014:+leaves the second factor unchanged and independent of the conditioned first
4015:+factor.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
4016:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
4017:+theorem Distribution.restrict_prod_fst {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
4018:+    [DecidableEq β] (μ : Distribution α) (ν : Distribution β)
4019:+    (hν : ν.IsProbability) (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
4020:+    (hpos : 0 < ∑ a ∈ μ.support.filter p, μ.weight a)
4021:+    (hpos' : 0 < ∑ w ∈ (Distribution.prod μ ν).support.filter
4022:+        (fun w => p w.1), (Distribution.prod μ ν).weight w) :
4023:+    Distribution.restrict (Distribution.prod μ ν) (fun w => p w.1) hpos' =
4024:+      Distribution.prod (Distribution.restrict μ p hpos) ν := by
4025:+  classical
4026:+  have hsupp : (Distribution.prod μ ν).support.filter (fun w => p w.1) =
4027:+      (μ.support.filter p) ×ˢ ν.support := by
4028:+    change (μ.support ×ˢ ν.support).filter (fun w => p w.1) =
4029:+      (μ.support.filter p) ×ˢ ν.support
4030:+    ext w
4031:+    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product]
4032:+    tauto
4033:+  have hmass : (∑ w ∈ (Distribution.prod μ ν).support.filter
4034:+        (fun w => p w.1), (Distribution.prod μ ν).weight w) =
4035:+      ∑ a ∈ μ.support.filter p, μ.weight a := by
4036:+    rw [hsupp]
4037:+    have h1 : (∑ w ∈ (μ.support.filter p) ×ˢ ν.support,
4038:+        (Distribution.prod μ ν).weight w) =
4039:+        ∑ a ∈ μ.support.filter p, ∑ b ∈ ν.support,
4040:+          μ.weight a * ν.weight b := by
4041:+      rw [Finset.sum_product]
4042:+      rfl
4043:+    rw [h1, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ =>
4044:+        (Finset.mul_sum ν.support (fun b => ν.weight b) (μ.weight a)).symm,
4045:+      hν.weight_sum_eq_one]
4046:+    simp

4216:+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.Lines.SubLineProduct
4217:+
4218:+/-!
4219:+# Reshuffling products of finitely supported laws
4220:+
4221:+The sampling procedure of the sub-line lemma produces its six independent
4222:+generating blocks in one grouping, while the restricted line-point laws that
4223:+the projected marginals must match present the same six blocks in another
4224:+grouping.  This module records the rewriting rules that pass between two such
4225:+presentations: the support and the weight of a product, the fact that a
4226:+push-forward along a bijection is determined by the supports and weights it
4227:+compares, and the push-forward of the second factor of a product.
4228:+
4229:+## References
4230:+
4231:+The rewriting rules support `lem:qld-sublines` in
4232:+blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, whose source is
4233:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`.
4234:+The product operation is that of blueprint
4235:+`def:line-point-dist`.
4236:+-/
4237:+
4238:+open scoped BigOperators
4239:+
4240:+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
4241:+
4242:+open MIPStarRE.LDT
4243:+
4244:+noncomputable section
4245:+
4246:+/-! ## The support and the weight of a product -/
4247:+
4248:+/-- The support of a product law is the product of the supports.  Blueprint
4249:+`def:line-point-dist`, paper
4250:+`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:274-287`.
4251:+-/
4252:+theorem Distribution.prod_support {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
4253:+    [DecidableEq β] (μ : Distribution α) (ν : Distribution β) :
4254:+    (Distribution.prod μ ν).support = μ.support ×ˢ ν.support := rfl
4255:+
4256:+/-- The weight of a product law is the product of the weights.  Blueprint
4257:+`def:line-point-dist`, paper
4258:+`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:274-287`.
4259:+-/
4260:+theorem Distribution.prod_weight {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
4261:+    [DecidableEq β] (μ : Distribution α) (ν : Distribution β) (w : α × β) :
4262:+    (Distribution.prod μ ν).weight w = μ.weight w.1 * ν.weight w.2 := rfl
4263:+
4264:+/-! ## Push-forward along a bijection -/
4265:+
4266:+/-- A push-forward along a bijection is identified by the supports and the
4267:+weights it compares: if the map matches the two supports and carries each
4268:+weight to the corresponding weight, and if it has a two-sided inverse, the
4269:+push-forward is the target law.  Blueprint
4270:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
4271:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
4272:+theorem Distribution.map_bijective_eq {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
4273:+    [DecidableEq β] (μ : Distribution α) (ν : Distribution β) (f : α → β)
4274:+    (g : β → α) (hgf : ∀ a, g (f a) = a) (hfg : ∀ b, f (g b) = b)
4275:+    (hs : ∀ a, a ∈ μ.support ↔ f a ∈ ν.support)
4276:+    (hw : ∀ a, μ.weight a = ν.weight (f a)) :
4277:+    μ.map f = ν := by
4278:+  classical
4279:+  refine Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight ?_ ?_
4280:+  · rw [Distribution.map_support]
4281:+    ext b
4282:+    simp only [Finset.mem_image]
4283:+    constructor
4284:+    · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
4285:+      exact (hs a).mp ha
4286:+    · intro hb
4287:+      refine ⟨g b, (hs (g b)).mpr ?_, hfg b⟩
4288:+      rw [hfg b]
4289:+      exact hb
4290:+  · funext b
4291:+    rw [Distribution.map_weight]
4292:+    have hfilter : μ.support.filter (fun a => f a = b) =
4293:+        μ.support.filter (fun a => a = g b) := by
4294:+      ext a
4295:+      simp only [Finset.mem_filter]
4296:+      constructor
4297:+      · rintro ⟨ha, h⟩
4298:+        exact ⟨ha, by rw [← h, hgf]⟩
4299:+      · rintro ⟨ha, h⟩
4300:+        exact ⟨ha, by rw [h, hfg]⟩
4301:+    rw [hfilter, Finset.filter_eq' μ.support (g b)]
4302:+    by_cases hmem : g b ∈ μ.support
4303:+    · rw [if_pos hmem, Finset.sum_singleton, hw (g b), hfg]
4304:+    · rw [if_neg hmem, Finset.sum_empty]
4305:+      refine (ν.outsideSupport b ?_).symm
4306:+      intro hb
4307:+      exact hmem ((hs (g b)).mpr (by rw [hfg b]; exact hb))
4308:+
4309:+/-! ## Push-forward of the second factor of a product -/
4310:+
4311:+/-- Pushing the second factor of a product forward is pushing the product
4312:+forward along the map acting on that factor alone.  Blueprint
4313:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
4314:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
4315:+theorem Distribution.prod_map_right {α β γ : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
4316:+    [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ] (μ : Distribution α) (ν : Distribution β)
4317:+    (g : β → γ) :
4318:+    Distribution.prod μ (ν.map g) =
4319:+      (Distribution.prod μ ν).map (fun w => (w.1, g w.2)) := by
4320:+  classical
4321:+  refine Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight ?_ ?_
4322:+  · change μ.support ×ˢ (ν.support.image g) =
4323:+      (μ.support ×ˢ ν.support).image (fun w => (w.1, g w.2))
4324:+    ext w
4325:+    obtain ⟨x, c⟩ := w
4326:+    simp only [Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_image, Prod.mk.injEq, Prod.exists]
4327:+    constructor
4328:+    · rintro ⟨hx, b, hb, rfl⟩
4329:+      exact ⟨x, b, ⟨hx, hb⟩, rfl, rfl⟩
4330:+    · rintro ⟨a, b, ⟨ha, hb⟩, rfl, rfl⟩
4331:+      exact ⟨ha, b, hb, rfl⟩
4332:+  · funext w
4333:+    obtain ⟨x, c⟩ := w
4334:+    have hfilter :
4335:+        (μ.support ×ˢ ν.support).filter (fun p => (p.1, g p.2) = (x, c)) =
4336:+          (μ.support.filter (fun a => a = x)) ×ˢ
4337:+            (ν.support.filter (fun b => g b = c)) := by
4338:+      ext p
4339:+      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Prod.mk.injEq]
4340:+      tauto
4341:+    have hx : ∑ a ∈ μ.support.filter (fun a => a = x), μ.weight a =
4342:+        μ.weight x := by
4343:+      rw [Finset.filter_eq' μ.support x]
4344:+      by_cases hmem : x ∈ μ.support
4345:+      · rw [if_pos hmem, Finset.sum_singleton]
4346:+      · rw [if_neg hmem, Finset.sum_empty, μ.outsideSupport x hmem]
4347:+    change μ.weight x * (ν.map g).weight c =
4348:+      ∑ p ∈ (μ.support ×ˢ ν.support).filter (fun p => (p.1, g p.2) = (x, c)),
4349:+        μ.weight p.1 * ν.weight p.2
4350:+    rw [hfilter, Finset.sum_product,
4351:+      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ =>
4352:+        (Finset.mul_sum (ν.support.filter (fun b => g b = c))
4353:+          (fun b => ν.weight b) (μ.weight a)).symm),
4354:+      ← Finset.sum_mul, hx]
4355:+    rfl
4356:+
4357:+end
4358:+
4359:+end MIPStarRE.QPBT

4366:+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.Lines.SubLineConstruct

4369:+/-!
4370:+# The projected marginals of the sub-line law
4371:+
4372:+This module identifies the two projected point marginals of the sub-line law
4373:+of `lem:qld-sublines` as mixtures of the restricted product laws.  The two
4374:+source lines of a sampled triple depend on the drawn extended point only
4375:+through the canonical representatives of its two source blocks, and those
4376:+representatives are unchanged when the drawn point is replaced by any point of
4377:+the extended line; a uniform point of the extended line through a uniform
4378:+point is a uniform point, so the drawn point may be replaced throughout by the
4379:+point that is finally retained.  The six generating blocks of the resulting
4380:+law -- the two source point blocks, the two scalar seeds and the two source
4381:+direction blocks -- are then regrouped into the two restricted product laws
4382:+carried by the two indices of the branch.
4383:+
4384:+## References
4385:+
4386:+The identification is the last step of the proof of `lem:qld-sublines` in
4387:+blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, whose source is
4388:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`.
4389:+The restricted laws are `def:ith-restricted-line`, blueprint lines
4390:+1209--1228, paper lines 1038--1048.
4391:+-/
4392:+
4393:+open scoped BigOperators
4394:+
4395:+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
4396:+
4397:+open MIPStarRE.LDT
4398:+
4399:+noncomputable section
4400:+
4401:+/-! ## Source lines depend on the point block only through its representative -/
4402:+
4403:+/-- Two source lines of the same branch with the same seed and the same source
4404:+direction block agree as soon as their point blocks have the same canonical
4405:+representative in the direction of that line.  Blueprint
4406:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
4407:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
4408:+theorem subLineSourceLine_congr (P : AdmissibleParams) (kind : LineKind)
4409:+    (b b' : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (s : ScalarQ P.toLdParams)
4410:+    (d : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
4411:+    (h : lineRepMap
4412:+        (subLineSourceDirection P kind (chiIndex P.toLdParams s) d) b =
4413:+      lineRepMap
4414:+        (subLineSourceDirection P kind (chiIndex P.toLdParams s) d) b') :
4415:+    subLineSourceLine P kind b s d = subLineSourceLine P kind b' s d := by
4416:+  cases kind
4417:+  · exact lineDesc_axis_congr h _ _
4418:+  · exact lineDesc_diagonal_congr h rfl _ _ _ _
4419:+
4420:+/-- Replacing the drawn extended point by a point of the extended line does
4421:+not change the canonical representative of its `X` block in the direction of
4422:+the source `X` line of the branch.  Blueprint
4423:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
4424:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
4425:+theorem lineRepMap_projX_subLineExtLine_point (P : AdmissibleParams)
4426:+    (kind : LineKind) (k : Fin (2 * P.m + 2))
4427:+    (x e : Fin (2 * P.m + 2) → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd)
4428:+    (t : DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd) :
4429:+    lineRepMap
4430:+        (subLineSourceDirection P kind (subLineXIndex P k)
4431:+          (projX (directPointToPauli P e)))
4432:+        (projX (directPointToPauli P
4433:+          (lineRepMap (subLineExtDirection P kind k e) x +
4434:+            t • subLineExtDirection P kind k e))) =
4435:+      lineRepMap
4436:+        (subLineSourceDirection P kind (subLineXIndex P k)
4437:+          (projX (directPointToPauli P e)))
4438:+        (projX (directPointToPauli P x)) := by
4439:+  have hspan := projX_subLineExtDirection_mem_span P kind k e
4440:+  have hrep : lineRepMap (subLineExtDirection P kind k e)
4441:+      (lineRepMap (subLineExtDirection P kind k e) x +
4442:+        t • subLineExtDirection P kind k e) =
4443:+      lineRepMap (subLineExtDirection P kind k e) x := by
4444:+    rw [lineRepMap_add_smul, lineRepMap_apply_self]
4445:+  have h1 := lineRepMap_projX_directPointToPauli_lineRepMap P
4446:+    (subLineExtDirection P kind k e)
4447:+    (lineRepMap (subLineExtDirection P kind k e) x +
4448:+      t • subLineExtDirection P kind k e)
4449:+    (subLineSourceDirection P kind (subLineXIndex P k)
4450:+      (projX (directPointToPauli P e))) hspan
4451:+  have h2 := lineRepMap_projX_directPointToPauli_lineRepMap P
4452:+    (subLineExtDirection P kind k e) x
4453:+    (subLineSourceDirection P kind (subLineXIndex P k)
4454:+      (projX (directPointToPauli P e))) hspan
4455:+  rw [← h1, ← h2, hrep]

4929:+/-!
4930:+# Generating laws of the restricted line-point distributions
4931:+
4932:+This module rewrites the two restricted line-point laws of
4933:+`def:ith-restricted-line` as push-forwards of a single uniformly sampled
4934:+low-degree vector conditioned on the coordinate-index fiber of its retained
4935:+scalar seed.  In that form the point block, the seed and the direction block
4936:+of the sampled vector are visibly the independent generating data of the
4937:+restricted law, which is the description used by the sampling procedure of the
4938:+sub-line lemma: there the projected pairs are built either from a direction
4939:+block inherited from the extended line or from freshly sampled data, and each
4940:+is asserted to follow a restricted law.
4941:+
4942:+## References
4943:+
4944:+The generating descriptions support `lem:qld-sublines` in
4945:+blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, whose source is
4946:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`.
4947:+The restricted laws themselves are `def:ith-restricted-line`, blueprint lines
4948:+1209--1228, paper lines 1038--1048.
4949:+-/
4950:+
4951:+open scoped BigOperators
4952:+
4953:+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
4954:+
4955:+open MIPStarRE.LDT
4956:+
4957:+noncomputable section

4959:+/-! ## Restriction of a push-forward -/
4960:+
4961:+/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: restricting a push-forward distribution to a
4962:+decidable event is the push-forward of the restriction to the pre-image of
4963:+that event.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
4964:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
4965:+theorem Distribution.restrict_map {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
4966:+    (μ : Distribution α) (f : α → β) (p : β → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
4967:+    (q : α → Prop) [DecidablePred q] (hq : ∀ a, q a ↔ p (f a))
4968:+    (hpos : 0 < ∑ b ∈ (μ.map f).support.filter p, (μ.map f).weight b)
4969:+    (hpos' : 0 < ∑ a ∈ μ.support.filter q, μ.weight a) :
4970:+    Distribution.restrict (μ.map f) p hpos =
4971:+      (Distribution.restrict μ q hpos').map f := by
4972:+  classical
4973:+  have hfiber : ∀ b : β, p b →
4974:+      μ.support.filter (fun a => f a = b) =
4975:+        (μ.support.filter q).filter (fun a => f a = b) := by
4976:+    intro b hb
4977:+    ext a
4978:+    simp only [Finset.mem_filter]
4979:+    constructor
4980:+    · rintro ⟨ha, hab⟩
4981:+      exact ⟨⟨ha, (hq a).mpr (hab ▸ hb)⟩, hab⟩
4982:+    · rintro ⟨⟨ha, -⟩, hab⟩
4983:+      exact ⟨ha, hab⟩
4984:+  have himg : (μ.map f).support.filter p = (μ.support.filter q).image f := by
4985:+    ext b
4986:+    simp only [Distribution.map_support, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_image]
4987:+    constructor
4988:+    · rintro ⟨⟨a, ha, rfl⟩, hpb⟩
4989:+      exact ⟨a, ⟨ha, (hq a).mpr hpb⟩, rfl⟩
4990:+    · rintro ⟨a, ⟨ha1, ha2⟩, rfl⟩
4991:+      exact ⟨⟨a, ha1, rfl⟩, (hq a).mp ha2⟩
4992:+  have hmass : (∑ b ∈ (μ.map f).support.filter p, (μ.map f).weight b) =
4993:+      ∑ a ∈ μ.support.filter q, μ.weight a := by
4994:+    rw [himg]
4995:+    rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
4996:+      (s := μ.support.filter q) (t := (μ.support.filter q).image f)
4997:+      (g := f) (fun a ha => Finset.mem_image_of_mem f ha) μ.weight]
4998:+    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b hb => ?_
4999:+    obtain ⟨a0, ha0, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hb
5000:+    rw [Distribution.map_weight,
5001:+      hfiber _ ((hq a0).mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha0).2)]
5002:+  refine Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight ?_ ?_
5003:+  · exact himg
5004:+  · funext b
5005:+    show (if p b then (μ.map f).weight b /
5006:+        ∑ c ∈ (μ.map f).support.filter p, (μ.map f).weight c else 0) =
5007:+      ∑ a ∈ (μ.support.filter q).filter (fun a => f a = b),
5008:+        (if q a then μ.weight a / ∑ c ∈ μ.support.filter q, μ.weight c else 0)
5009:+    by_cases hb : p b
5010:+    · rw [if_pos hb, hmass, Distribution.map_weight, hfiber b hb,
5011:+        Finset.sum_div]
5012:+      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a ha => ?_
5013:+      rw [if_pos (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).1).2]
5014:+    · rw [if_neg hb]
5015:+      refine (Finset.sum_eq_zero fun a ha => ?_).symm
5016:+      obtain ⟨ha1, ha2⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp ha
5017:+      exact absurd (ha2 ▸ (hq a).mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha1).2) hb

5019:+/-! ## The coordinate-index event on a single uniform vector -/
5020:+
5021:+/-- The coordinate-index event of `def:ith-restricted-line` read on the single
5022:+uniformly sampled low-degree vector that generates the line-point laws.
5023:+Blueprint `def:ith-restricted-line`, paper
5024:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1038-1048`. -/
5025:+def ldSeedEvent (L : LdParams) (i : Fin L.m) (z : LdSpace L) : Prop :=
5026:+  chiIndex L (LdSpace.seed z) = i
5027:+
5028:+/-- Decidability of the coordinate-index event. -/
5029:+instance ldSeedEvent_decidablePred (L : LdParams) (i : Fin L.m) :
5030:+    DecidablePred (ldSeedEvent L i) := by
5031:+  intro z
5032:+  unfold ldSeedEvent
5033:+  infer_instance
5034:+
5035:+/-- The coordinate-index event has positive mass under the uniform law on
5036:+low-degree vectors, so the conditioning below is normalized.  Blueprint
5037:+`def:ith-restricted-line`, paper
5038:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1038-1048`. -/
5039:+theorem ldSeedEvent_positive (L : LdParams) (i : Fin L.m) :
5040:+    0 < ∑ z ∈ (uniformDistribution (LdSpace L)).support.filter
5041:+        (ldSeedEvent L i),
5042:+      (uniformDistribution (LdSpace L)).weight z := by
5043:+  classical
5044:+  refine Finset.sum_pos'
5045:+    (fun a _ => (uniformDistribution (LdSpace L)).nonnegative a)
5046:+    ⟨(fun _ => seedOfIndexResidue L i ⟨0, L.seedFiberCard_pos⟩),
5047:+      Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨by simp, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
5048:+  · show chiIndex L (seedOfIndexResidue L i ⟨0, L.seedFiberCard_pos⟩) = i
5049:+    exact chiIndex_seedOfIndexResidue L i _
5050:+  · simp only [uniformDistribution, Distribution.uniformOnFinset_weight,
5051:+      Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
5052:+    positivity
5053:+
5054:+/-! ## Canonical representatives are unchanged by the conditioning maps -/
5055:+
5056:+/-- Two axis-line descriptions with the same seed and the same base agree:
5057:+the stored proof of `def:line-representative` invariance is a proposition and
5058:+carries no further data.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
5059:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
5060:+theorem lineDesc_axis_congr {L : LdParams}
5061:+    {b b' : Fin L.m → ScalarQ L} {s : ScalarQ L} (h : b = b')
5062:+    (hb : lineRepMap (coordinateDirection (chiIndex L s)) b = b)
5063:+    (hb' : lineRepMap (coordinateDirection (chiIndex L s)) b' = b') :
5064:+    LineDesc.axis b s hb = LineDesc.axis b' s hb' := by
5065:+  subst h
5066:+  rfl
5067:+
5068:+/-- Two diagonal-line descriptions with the same seed, the same base and the
5069:+same direction agree: the stored proofs of `def:line-representative`
5070:+invariance and of the prefix-zero condition are propositions and carry no
5071:+further data.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
5072:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
5073:+theorem lineDesc_diagonal_congr {L : LdParams}
5074:+    {b b' d d' : Fin L.m → ScalarQ L} {s : ScalarQ L}
5075:+    (hb : b = b') (hd : d = d')
5076:+    (h1 : lineRepMap d b = b)
5077:+    (h2 : ∀ j : Fin L.m, j.val < (chiIndex L s).val → d j = 0)
5078:+    (h1' : lineRepMap d' b' = b')
5079:+    (h2' : ∀ j : Fin L.m, j.val < (chiIndex L s).val → d' j = 0) :
5080:+    LineDesc.diagonal b s d h1 h2 = LineDesc.diagonal b' s d' h1' h2' := by
5081:+  subst hb
5082:+  subst hd
5083:+  rfl
5084:+
5085:+/-- The axis-line decoder is unchanged by the axis conditioning map: the
5086:+canonical representative of `def:line-representative` is idempotent, so
5087:+decoding the conditioned vector and decoding the original vector agree.
5088:+Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
5089:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
5090:+theorem aLineDescOf_ldALineCL (L : LdParams) (z : LdSpace L) :
5091:+    aLineDescOf L (ldALineCL L z) = aLineDescOf L z :=
5092:+  lineDesc_axis_congr (lineRepMap_apply_self _ _) _ _
5093:+
5094:+/-- The diagonal-line decoder is unchanged by the diagonal conditioning map:
5095:+the prefix projection and the canonical representative of
5096:+`def:line-representative` are both idempotent.  Blueprint
5097:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
5098:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
5099:+theorem dLineDescOf_ldDLineCL (L : LdParams) (z : LdSpace L) :
5100:+    dLineDescOf L (ldDLineCL L z) = dLineDescOf L z := by
5101:+  have hdir : prefixProjection (chiIndex L (LdSpace.seed (ldDLineCL L z)))
5102:+        (LdSpace.direction (ldDLineCL L z))
5103:+      = prefixProjection (chiIndex L (LdSpace.seed z)) (LdSpace.direction z) :=
5104:+    prefixProjection_idempotent _ _
5105:+  have hpt : lineRepMap
5106:+        (prefixProjection (chiIndex L (LdSpace.seed (ldDLineCL L z)))
5107:+          (LdSpace.direction (ldDLineCL L z)))
5108:+        (LdSpace.point (ldDLineCL L z))
5109:+      = lineRepMap
5110:+        (prefixProjection (chiIndex L (LdSpace.seed z)) (LdSpace.direction z))
5111:+        (LdSpace.point z) := by
5112:+    rw [hdir]
5113:+    exact lineRepMap_apply_self _ _
5114:+  exact lineDesc_diagonal_congr hpt hdir _ _ _ _

5185:+/-!
5186:+# Uniformity under the identification of the two scalar fields
5187:+
5188:+The extended line of the sub-line construction lives over the scalar field of
5189:+the directly indexed extended game, while the two source lines live over the
5190:+scalar field of the Pauli basis test.  The two fields are identified
5191:+coordinatewise by a field isomorphism, so that identification is a bijection
5192:+of the coordinate spaces and therefore carries uniform laws to uniform laws.
5193:+This module records that transport for a whole extended point and for the two
5194:+source blocks of an extended point, and it records the resampling rule that
5195:+reading a function at the point of a uniformly random affine parameter on the
5196:+line through the canonical representative of a uniformly random point is the
5197:+same as reading that function at a uniformly random point.
5198:+
5199:+## References
5200:+
5201:+The statements support `lem:qld-sublines` in
5202:+blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, whose source is
5203:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`.
5204:+The coordinate blocks are those of `def:combine-map`, blueprint lines
5205:+445--480, paper lines 970--989.
5206:+-/
5207:+
5208:+open scoped BigOperators
5209:+
5210:+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
5211:+
5212:+open MIPStarRE.LDT
5213:+

5216:+/-! ## The identification of the two scalar fields as a bijection -/
5217:+
5218:+/-- The coordinatewise identification of the extended scalar field with the
5219:+source scalar field on one source block, presented as a bijection.  Blueprint
5220:+`def:combine-map`, paper
5221:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:970-989`. -/

5224:+  toFun v := fun i => extendedDirectScalarEquiv P (v i)
5225:+  invFun v := fun i => (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).symm (v i)
5226:+  left_inv v := by
5227:+    funext i
5228:+    simp
5229:+  right_inv v := by
5230:+    funext i
5231:+    simp

5239:+      (Fin (2 * P.m + 2) → PauliScalar P) where
5240:+  toFun := directPointToPauli P
5241:+  invFun v := fun i => (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).symm (v i)
5242:+  left_inv v := by
5243:+    funext i
5244:+    simp [directPointToPauli]
5245:+  right_inv v := by
5246:+    funext i
5247:+    simp [directPointToPauli]

5250:+block.  Blueprint `def:combine-map`, paper

5263:+/-! ## Transport of the uniform laws -/

5270:+          (Fin (2 * P.m + 2) → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd)).map

5272:+      uniformDistribution (Fin (2 * P.m + 2) → PauliScalar P) :=
5273:+  uniformDistribution_map_equiv (directPointToPauliEquiv P)

5275:+/-- A uniformly random source block transported to the source scalar field is

5278:+theorem uniformDistribution_map_directBlockToPauli (P : AdmissibleParams) :

5280:+        (fun v => directBlockToPauliEquiv P v) =
5281:+      uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :=
5282:+  uniformDistribution_map_equiv (directBlockToPauliEquiv P)

5284:+/-- The two source blocks of a uniformly random extended point, read in the

5287:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/

5336:+/-!
5337:+# Uniform points of a line and the blocks of a coordinate direction
5338:+
5339:+This module records the two elementary geometric inputs of the sampling
5340:+procedure of the sub-line lemma. First, for independent uniform inputs `y` in
5341:+the ambient coordinate space and `t` in the scalar field, the point
5342:+`lineRepMap v y + t • v` is uniform. This map on ambient-point--parameter pairs
5343:+has fibers of size `q`: for nonzero `v`, `y` varies over a coset of the span of
5344:+`v`, while its canonical representative and `t` are fixed; for zero `v`, `y`
5345:+is fixed and `t` is free. Second, the two coordinate
5346:+blocks of an elementary coordinate direction of the extended space are the
5347:+corresponding elementary direction of the source space in the block that
5348:+carries the coordinate, and zero in the other block and at the two scalar
5349:+coordinates.
5350:+
5351:+## References
5352:+
5353:+The two statements support `lem:qld-sublines` in
5354:+blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, whose source is
5355:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`.
5356:+The canonical representative map is blueprint
5357:+`def:line-representative`; the coordinate blocks are those of
5358:+blueprint `def:combine-map`.
5359:+-/
5360:+
5361:+open scoped BigOperators
5362:+
5363:+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
5364:+
5365:+open MIPStarRE.LDT
5366:+
5367:+noncomputable section
5368:+
5369:+/-! ## The canonical representative for the zero direction -/
5370:+
5371:+/-- For the zero direction the canonical representative map of
5372:+`def:line-representative` is the identity, since the span of the zero vector
5373:+is trivial.  Blueprint `def:line-representative`, paper
5374:+`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:143-174`.
5375:+-/
5376:+theorem lineRepMap_zero_apply {K : Type*} [Field K] {m : ℕ}
5377:+    (u : Fin m → K) : lineRepMap (0 : Fin m → K) u = u := by
5378:+  have hspan : Submodule.span K ({0} : Set (Fin m → K)) = ⊥ := by simp
5379:+  have h := sub_lineRepMap_mem_span (0 : Fin m → K) u
5380:+  rw [hspan, Submodule.mem_bot, sub_eq_zero] at h
5381:+  exact h.symm
5382:+
5383:+/-! ## Uniform points of a line -/
5384:+
5385:+/-- The point at a uniformly random affine parameter on the line through the
5386:+canonical representative of a uniformly random point is uniformly random on
5387:+the whole coordinate space.  Every fiber of the parameterization has exactly
5388:+`q` elements in the ambient-point--parameter domain: for a nonzero direction
5389:+the parameter and canonical representative are determined, while the input
5390:+point varies over a coset of the span of the direction. For the zero direction
5391:+the input point is fixed and the parameter is free. Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
5392:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
5393:+theorem uniformDistribution_map_lineRepMap_add_smul {K : Type*} [Field K]
5394:+    [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] {m : ℕ} (v : Fin m → K) :
5395:+    (uniformDistribution ((Fin m → K) × K)).map
5396:+        (fun w => lineRepMap v w.1 + w.2 • v) =
5397:+      uniformDistribution (Fin m → K) := by
5398:+  refine uniformDistribution_map_of_card_fiber _ (Fintype.card K) fun x => ?_
5399:+  by_cases hv : v = 0
5400:+  · subst hv
5401:+    have hfilter :
5402:+        ((Finset.univ : Finset ((Fin m → K) × K)).filter
5403:+            fun w => lineRepMap (0 : Fin m → K) w.1 + w.2 • (0 : Fin m → K)
5404:+              = x)
5405:+          = ({x} : Finset (Fin m → K)) ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset K) := by
5406:+      ext w
5407:+      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
5408:+        Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_singleton, and_true, smul_zero,
5409:+        add_zero, lineRepMap_zero_apply]
5410:+    rw [hfilter, Finset.card_product]
5411:+    simp
5412:+  · have hinj : Function.Injective
5413:+        (fun c : K => (lineRepMap v x + c • v, directLineRepParameter v x)) := by
5414:+      intro c₁ c₂ hc
5415:+      have hc' : c₁ • v = c₂ • v := by
5416:+        have h := congrArg Prod.fst hc
5417:+        simpa using h
5418:+      have hsub : (c₁ - c₂) • v = 0 := by
5419:+        rw [sub_smul, hc', sub_self]
5420:+      rcases smul_eq_zero.mp hsub with h | h
5421:+      · exact sub_eq_zero.mp h
5422:+      · exact absurd h hv
5423:+    have himg :
5424:+        ((Finset.univ : Finset ((Fin m → K) × K)).filter
5425:+            fun w => lineRepMap v w.1 + w.2 • v = x)
5426:+          = (Finset.univ : Finset K).image
5427:+              (fun c => (lineRepMap v x + c • v,
5428:+                directLineRepParameter v x)) := by
5429:+      ext w
5430:+      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_image]
5431:+      constructor
5432:+      · intro hw
5433:+        have hrep : lineRepMap v w.1 = lineRepMap v x := by
5434:+          rw [← hw, lineRepMap_add_smul, lineRepMap_apply_self]
5435:+        have hx : x = lineRepMap v x + w.2 • v := by
5436:+          rw [← hrep]
5437:+          exact hw.symm
5438:+        have ht : directLineRepParameter v x = w.2 :=
5439:+          directLineRepParameter_eq_of_nonzero hv hx
5440:+        obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp
5441:+          (sub_lineRepMap_mem_span v w.1)
5442:+        refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
5443:+        have hw1 : lineRepMap v x + c • v = w.1 := by
5444:+          rw [← hrep, hc]
5445:+          abel
5446:+        rw [Prod.ext_iff]
5447:+        exact ⟨hw1, ht⟩
5448:+      · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
5449:+        show lineRepMap v (lineRepMap v x + c • v) +
5450:+          directLineRepParameter v x • v = x
5451:+        rw [lineRepMap_add_smul, lineRepMap_apply_self]
5452:+        exact (directLineRepParameter_spec v x).symm
5453:+    rw [himg, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hinj, Finset.card_univ]
5454:+

5591:+a coordinatewise field isomorphism.  Blueprint
5592:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
5593:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
5594:+theorem directPointToPauli_mem_linePoints (P : AdmissibleParams)
5595:+    {b d x : Fin P.extendedDirectLd.m → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd}
5596:+    (hx : x ∈ linePoints b d) :
5597:+    directPointToPauli P x ∈
5598:+      linePoints (directPointToPauli P b) (directPointToPauli P d) := by
5599:+  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hx
5600:+  refine ⟨extendedDirectScalarEquiv P t, ?_⟩
5601:+  funext i
5602:+  simp [directPointToPauli]
5603:+
5604:+/-- The `X` block of a point of a line lies on the source line through the
5605:+canonical representative of the `X` block of the base, as soon as the `X`
5606:+block of the direction is a multiple of the source direction.  Blueprint
5607:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
5608:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
5609:+theorem projX_mem_linePoints {K : Type*} [Field K] {m : ℕ}
5610:+    (b d : Fin (2 * m + 2) → K) (dX : Fin m → K)
5611:+    (hd : projX d ∈ Submodule.span K ({dX} : Set (Fin m → K)))
5612:+    {x : Fin (2 * m + 2) → K} (hx : x ∈ linePoints b d) :
5613:+    projX x ∈ linePoints (lineRepMap dX (projX b)) dX := by
5614:+  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hx
5615:+  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hd
5616:+  rw [linePoints_eq_of_mem _ dX (projX b)
5617:+    (mem_linePoints_lineRepMap dX (projX b))]
5618:+  refine ⟨t * c, ?_⟩
5619:+  rw [projX_add, projX_smul, ← hc]
5620:+  module
5621:+
5622:+/-- The `Z` block of a point of a line lies on the source line through the
5623:+canonical representative of the `Z` block of the base, as soon as the `Z`
5624:+block of the direction is a multiple of the source direction.  Blueprint
5625:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
5626:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
5627:+theorem projZ_mem_linePoints {K : Type*} [Field K] {m : ℕ}
5628:+    (b d : Fin (2 * m + 2) → K) (dZ : Fin m → K)
5629:+    (hd : projZ d ∈ Submodule.span K ({dZ} : Set (Fin m → K)))
5630:+    {x : Fin (2 * m + 2) → K} (hx : x ∈ linePoints b d) :
5631:+    projZ x ∈ linePoints (lineRepMap dZ (projZ b)) dZ := by
5632:+  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hx
5633:+  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hd
5634:+  rw [linePoints_eq_of_mem _ dZ (projZ b)
5635:+    (mem_linePoints_lineRepMap dZ (projZ b))]
5636:+  refine ⟨t * c, ?_⟩
5637:+  rw [projZ_add, projZ_smul, ← hc]
5638:+  module

5640:+/-! ## Incidence of the blocks of an extended line -/
5641:+
5642:+/-- The identification of the extended scalar field with the source scalar
5643:+field carries an elementary coordinate direction to the elementary coordinate
5644:+direction at the same coordinate.  Blueprint
5645:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
5646:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
5647:+theorem directPointToPauli_coordinateDirection (P : AdmissibleParams)
5648:+    (k : Fin P.extendedDirectLd.m) :
5649:+    directPointToPauli P (coordinateDirection k) = coordinateDirection k := by
5650:+  funext j
5651:+  simp [directPointToPauli, coordinateDirection, Pi.single_apply]
5652:+
5653:+/-- Incidence of the `X` blocks: if a source line has as base the canonical
5654:+representative, in its own direction, of the `X` block of the base of an
5655:+extended line, and if the `X` block of the direction of the extended line
5656:+lies in the span of the source direction, then the `X` block of every point
5657:+of the extended line is a point of the source line.  Blueprint
5658:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
5659:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
5660:+theorem projX_mem_pointSet (P : AdmissibleParams)
5661:+    (base dir : Fin P.extendedDirectLd.m → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd)
5662:+    (lineX : LineDesc P.toLdParams)
5663:+    (hbase : lineX.base =
5664:+      lineRepMap lineX.direction (projX (directPointToPauli P base)))
5665:+    (hdir : projX (directPointToPauli P dir) ∈
5666:+      Submodule.span (PauliScalar P)
5667:+        ({lineX.direction} : Set (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)))
5668:+    {u : Fin P.extendedDirectLd.m → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd}
5669:+    (hu : u ∈ linePoints base dir) :
5670:+    projX (directPointToPauli P u) ∈ lineX.pointSet := by
5671:+  rw [LineDesc.pointSet, hbase]
5672:+  exact projX_mem_linePoints _ _ _ hdir (directPointToPauli_mem_linePoints P hu)
5673:+
5674:+/-- Incidence of the `Z` blocks: if a source line has as base the canonical
5675:+representative, in its own direction, of the `Z` block of the base of an
5676:+extended line, and if the `Z` block of the direction of the extended line
5677:+lies in the span of the source direction, then the `Z` block of every point
5678:+of the extended line is a point of the source line.  Blueprint
5679:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
5680:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
5681:+theorem projZ_mem_pointSet (P : AdmissibleParams)
5682:+    (base dir : Fin P.extendedDirectLd.m → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd)
5683:+    (lineZ : LineDesc P.toLdParams)
5684:+    (hbase : lineZ.base =
5685:+      lineRepMap lineZ.direction (projZ (directPointToPauli P base)))
5686:+    (hdir : projZ (directPointToPauli P dir) ∈
5687:+      Submodule.span (PauliScalar P)
5688:+        ({lineZ.direction} : Set (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)))
5689:+    {u : Fin P.extendedDirectLd.m → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd}
5690:+    (hu : u ∈ linePoints base dir) :
5691:+    projZ (directPointToPauli P u) ∈ lineZ.pointSet := by
5692:+  rw [LineDesc.pointSet, hbase]
5693:+  exact projZ_mem_linePoints _ _ _ hdir (directPointToPauli_mem_linePoints P hu)
5694:+
5695:+end

5704:+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.Witnesses

5707:+/-!
5708:+# The ordered point product on a single placement
5709:+
5710:+The consistency guarantees carried by the joint point measurement compare it
5711:+with the ordered `Z`-then-`X` product across a pair of opposite placements.
5712:+The scalar estimates used to combine the two Pauli bases instead need the two
5713:+families on one placement.  This module obtains that form by inserting the
5714:+joint measurement on the opposite placement and applying the squared-distance
5715:+triangle inequality twice.
5716:+
5717:+## References
5718:+
5719:+The statement is `lem:qld-4-10-same-placement` in
5720:+`blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex`; it restates the ordered
5721:+`Z`-then-`X` display of `lem:qld-4-10`, paper
5722:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:689-709`.
5723:+-/
5724:+
5725:+open scoped BigOperators
5726:+
5727:+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
5728:+
5729:+open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
5730:+open MIPStarRE.Quantum
5731:+
5732:+noncomputable section
5733:+
5734:+/-- Every placement has an opposite placement, and the relation is symmetric
5735:+between the two members of each pair. -/
5736:+theorem Placement.exists_isOpposite (p : Placement) :
5737:+    ∃ q : Placement, p.IsOpposite q ∧ q.IsOpposite p := by
5738:+  cases p with
5739:+  | AA' => exact ⟨.BA'', trivial, trivial⟩
5740:+  | BA'' => exact ⟨.AA', trivial, trivial⟩
5741:+  | BB' => exact ⟨.AB'', trivial, trivial⟩
5742:+  | AB'' => exact ⟨.BB', trivial, trivial⟩
5743:+
5744:+/-- On a single placement, the joint point measurement is close to the ordered
5745:+`Z`-then-`X` point product, with inflation factor four. -/
5746:+theorem CombinedPointsWitness.orderedZX_dist_le {P : AdmissibleParams}
5747:+    {ε δ : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P ε}
5748:+    (points : CombinedPointsWitness S δ) (p : Placement) :
5749:+    opFamilyDistSq
5750:+        (uniformDistribution
5751:+          ((Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) × (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)))
5752:+        (fun xz ab => S.place p ((points.Q p.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab))
5753:+        (fun xz ab => S.place p
5754:+          ((S.pointMeasExp p.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2 *
5755:+            (S.pointMeasExp p.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1))
5756:+        S.psiHat ≤ 4 * δ := by
5757:+  obtain ⟨q, hpq, hqp⟩ := p.exists_isOpposite
5758:+  have htri := opFamilyDistSq_le_of_le_of_le
5759:+    (uniformDistribution
5760:+      ((Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) × (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)))
5761:+    (fun xz ab => S.place p ((points.Q p.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab))
5762:+    (fun xz ab => S.place q ((points.Q q.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab))
5763:+    (fun xz ab => S.place p
5764:+      ((S.pointMeasExp p.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2 *
5765:+        (S.pointMeasExp p.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1))
5766:+    S.psiHat δ δ (points.self_consistent p q hpq)
5767:+    (points.consistent_ZX q p hqp)
5768:+  linarith
5769:+
5770:+end
5771:+
5772:+end MIPStarRE.QPBT

5779:+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Games.DistanceTheorems.Support

5782:+/-!
5783:+# Replacing one factor of a measurement-weighted overlap
5784:+
5785:+The scalar estimates used to combine the two Pauli bases compare averaged
5786:+overlaps whose left factor is one complete measurement and whose right factors
5787:+are operator families at small state-dependent distance.  This module records
5788:+the corresponding Cauchy--Schwarz estimate.  The right-hand families are
5789:+arbitrary, so the estimate covers an ordered product of point effects, which
5790:+is not itself a measurement.
5791:+
5792:+## References
5793:+
5794:+The estimate is `lem:overlap-gap-distance` in
5795:+`blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex`; it is the Cauchy--Schwarz
5796:+step at paper
5797:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1147-1166`.
5798:+-/
5799:+
5800:+open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
5801:+
5802:+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
5803:+
5804:+open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
5805:+open MIPStarRE.Quantum MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus
5806:+
5807:+/-- Replacing one operator family inside an overlap weighted on the left by a
5808:+complete measurement changes the average by at most the square root of the
5809:+state-dependent squared distance between the two families. -/
5810:+theorem abs_overlap_gap_le_sqrt_of_opFamilyDistSq {X α ι : Type*}
5811:+    [Fintype α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
5812:+    (μ : Distribution X) (A : X → Measurement α ι) (B C : X → α → Op ι)
5813:+    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (hμ : μ.IsProbability) (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1)
5814:+    (ζ : ℝ) (hBC : opFamilyDistSq μ B C ψ ≤ ζ) :
5815:+    |avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a : α, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * B x a)) -
5816:+        avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a : α, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * C x a))| ≤
5817:+      Real.sqrt ζ := by
5818:+  classical
5819:+  have hnorm_sq : ∀ M : Op ι,
5820:+      ‖applyOperatorToState M ψ‖ ^ 2 = stateQForm ψ (Mᴴ * M) := by
5821:+    intro M
5822:+    rw [@norm_sq_eq_re_inner ℂ]
5823:+    unfold stateQForm applyOperatorToState
5824:+    rw [Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_mul_self]
5825:+    change (inner ℂ (Matrix.toEuclideanLin M ψ) (Matrix.toEuclideanLin M ψ)).re =
5826:+      (inner ℂ ψ ((Matrix.toEuclideanLin M).adjoint
5827:+        (Matrix.toEuclideanLin M ψ))).re
5828:+    rw [LinearMap.adjoint_inner_right]
5829:+  have hmul : ∀ M N : Op ι, Mᴴ = M →
5830:+      stateQForm ψ (M * N) =
5831:+        (inner ℂ (applyOperatorToState M ψ)
5832:+          (applyOperatorToState N ψ)).re := by
5833:+    intro M N hM
5834:+    have hadjoint : (Matrix.toEuclideanLin M).adjoint =
5835:+        Matrix.toEuclideanLin M := by
5836:+      rw [← Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_eq_adjoint, hM]
5837:+    calc
5838:+      stateQForm ψ (M * N) =
5839:+          (inner ℂ ψ
5840:+            (applyOperatorToState M (applyOperatorToState N ψ))).re := by
5841:+        rw [stateQForm, applyOperatorToState_mul]
5842:+      _ = (inner ℂ ψ ((Matrix.toEuclideanLin M).adjoint
5843:+            (applyOperatorToState N ψ))).re := by
5844:+        rw [hadjoint]
5845:+        rfl
5846:+      _ = _ := by
5847:+        rw [LinearMap.adjoint_inner_right]
5848:+        rfl
5849:+  have hleft : ∀ x : X,
5850:+      (∑ a : α, ‖applyOperatorToState ((A x).effect a) ψ‖ ^ 2) ≤ 1 := by
5851:+    intro x
5852:+    have htotal : (∑ a : α, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a)) = 1 := by
5853:+      calc
5854:+        (∑ a : α, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a)) =
5855:+            stateQForm ψ (∑ a : α, (A x).effect a) := by
5856:+          simp [stateQForm, applyOperatorToState]
5857:+        _ = stateQForm ψ 1 := by rw [(A x).sum_eq_one]
5858:+        _ = 1 := by rw [stateQForm]; simp [applyOperatorToState, hψ]
5859:+    calc
5860:+      (∑ a : α, ‖applyOperatorToState ((A x).effect a) ψ‖ ^ 2) ≤
5861:+          ∑ a : α, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a) := by
5862:+        refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
5863:+        intro a _
5864:+        rw [hnorm_sq, measurement_effect_hermitian]
5865:+        exact quadratic_form_mono (MIPStarRE.Quantum.sq_le_self ((A x).pos a)
5866:+          (measurement_effect_le_one (A x) a)) ψ
5867:+      _ = 1 := htotal
5868:+  have hgnonneg : ∀ x : X,
5869:+      0 ≤ ∑ a : α, ‖applyOperatorToState (B x a - C x a) ψ‖ ^ 2 :=
5870:+    fun x => Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ => sq_nonneg _
5871:+  have hpoint : ∀ x : X,
5872:+      |∑ a : α, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * (B x a - C x a))| ≤
5873:+        Real.sqrt (∑ a : α, ‖applyOperatorToState (B x a - C x a) ψ‖ ^ 2) := by
5874:+    intro x
5875:+    let u : α → EuclideanSpace ℂ ι := fun a =>
5876:+      applyOperatorToState ((A x).effect a) ψ
5877:+    let v : α → EuclideanSpace ℂ ι := fun a =>
5878:+      applyOperatorToState (B x a - C x a) ψ
5879:+    have hrw : (∑ a : α, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * (B x a - C x a))) =
5880:+        ∑ a : α, (inner ℂ (u a) (v a)).re := by
5881:+      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
5882:+      intro a _
5883:+      exact hmul _ _ (measurement_effect_hermitian (A x) a)
5884:+    have hone : Real.sqrt (∑ a : α, ‖u a‖ ^ 2) ≤ 1 := by
5885:+      rw [← Real.sqrt_one]
5886:+      exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (hleft x)
5887:+    calc
5888:+      |∑ a : α, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * (B x a - C x a))| =
5889:+          |∑ a : α, (inner ℂ (u a) (v a)).re| := by rw [hrw]
5890:+      _ ≤ ∑ a : α, |(inner ℂ (u a) (v a)).re| :=
5891:+        Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
5892:+      _ ≤ ∑ a : α, ‖u a‖ * ‖v a‖ := by
5893:+        refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
5894:+        intro a _
5895:+        exact (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans (norm_inner_le_norm (u a) (v a))
5896:+      _ ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ a : α, ‖u a‖ ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (∑ a : α, ‖v a‖ ^ 2) := by
5897:+        simpa using Real.sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt
5898:+          (Finset.univ : Finset α) (fun a => ‖u a‖) (fun a => ‖v a‖)
5899:+      _ ≤ 1 * Real.sqrt (∑ a : α, ‖v a‖ ^ 2) :=
5900:+        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hone (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
5901:+      _ = Real.sqrt (∑ a : α,
5902:+            ‖applyOperatorToState (B x a - C x a) ψ‖ ^ 2) := one_mul _
5903:+  have hdiff :
5904:+      avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a : α, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * B x a)) -
5905:+          avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a : α,
5906:+            stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * C x a)) =
5907:+        avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a : α,
5908:+          stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * (B x a - C x a))) := by
5909:+    rw [← avgOver_sub]
5910:+    refine avgOver_congr μ _ _ ?_
5911:+    intro x
5912:+    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
5913:+    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
5914:+    intro a _
5915:+    simp [stateQForm, applyOperatorToState, mul_sub]
5916:+  rw [hdiff]
5917:+  refine le_trans
5918:+    (MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.avgOver_abs_le_sqrt_of_pointwise μ _ _
5919:+      hpoint hgnonneg (by rw [hμ.weight_sum_eq_one])) ?_
5920:+  exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hBC
5921:+
5922:+/-! ## The Cauchy--Schwarz inequality weighted by a positive operator -/
5923:+
5924:+/-- For a positive operator `A`, the sesquilinear form `⟨u, A v⟩` satisfies the
5925:+Cauchy--Schwarz inequality with the two diagonal values `⟨u, A u⟩` and
5926:+`⟨v, A v⟩`.  This is the inequality behind the Cauchy--Schwarz steps of the
5927:+proofs of `lem:claim-17-2` and `lem:claim-17-3`, in which both factors carry
5928:+the square root of the line effect, paper
5929:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1168-1209`. -/
5930:+theorem norm_inner_applyOperatorToState_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt {ι : Type*}
5931:+    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {A : Op ι} (hA : 0 ≤ A)
5932:+    (u v : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
5933:+    ‖inner ℂ u (applyOperatorToState A v)‖ ≤
5934:+      Real.sqrt (inner ℂ u (applyOperatorToState A u)).re *
5935:+        Real.sqrt (inner ℂ v (applyOperatorToState A v)).re := by
5936:+  set R : Op ι := CFC.sqrt A with hR
5937:+  have hRnonneg : 0 ≤ R := CFC.sqrt_nonneg A
5938:+  have hRR : R * R = A := CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self A hA
5939:+  have hRherm : Rᴴ = R :=
5940:+    (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp hRnonneg).isHermitian.eq
5941:+  have hadjoint : (Matrix.toEuclideanLin R).adjoint = Matrix.toEuclideanLin R := by
5942:+    rw [← Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_eq_adjoint, hRherm]
5943:+  have hsplit : ∀ w z : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι,
5944:+      inner ℂ w (applyOperatorToState A z) =
5945:+        inner ℂ (applyOperatorToState R w) (applyOperatorToState R z) := by
5946:+    intro w z
5947:+    have h := LinearMap.adjoint_inner_right (Matrix.toEuclideanLin R) w
5948:+      (Matrix.toEuclideanLin R z)
5949:+    rw [hadjoint] at h
5950:+    rw [← hRR, applyOperatorToState_mul]
5951:+    exact h
5952:+  have hnorm : ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι,
5953:+      ‖applyOperatorToState R w‖ =
5954:+        Real.sqrt (inner ℂ w (applyOperatorToState A w)).re := by
5955:+    intro w
5956:+    have h2 : ‖applyOperatorToState R w‖ ^ 2 =
5957:+        (inner ℂ (applyOperatorToState R w) (applyOperatorToState R w)).re := by
5958:+      rw [@norm_sq_eq_re_inner ℂ]
5959:+      rfl
5960:+    rw [hsplit, ← h2, Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)]
5961:+  rw [hsplit, ← hnorm, ← hnorm]
5962:+  exact norm_inner_le_norm _ _
5963:+
5964:+/-- The sum over outcomes of the real parts of `⟨u a, A a (v a)⟩`, for
5965:+positive weights `A a`, is bounded by the product of the square roots of the
5966:+two diagonal sums. -/
5967:+theorem abs_sum_re_inner_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α]
5968:+    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : α → Op ι) (hA : ∀ a, 0 ≤ A a)
5969:+    (u v : α → EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
5970:+    |∑ a, (inner ℂ (u a) (applyOperatorToState (A a) (v a))).re| ≤
5971:+      Real.sqrt (∑ a, (inner ℂ (u a) (applyOperatorToState (A a) (u a))).re) *
5972:+        Real.sqrt (∑ a, (inner ℂ (v a) (applyOperatorToState (A a) (v a))).re) := by
5973:+  have hu : ∀ a, 0 ≤ (inner ℂ (u a) (applyOperatorToState (A a) (u a))).re :=
5974:+    fun a => stateQForm_nonneg (u a) (hA a)
5975:+  have hv : ∀ a, 0 ≤ (inner ℂ (v a) (applyOperatorToState (A a) (v a))).re :=
5976:+    fun a => stateQForm_nonneg (v a) (hA a)
5977:+  calc
5978:+    |∑ a, (inner ℂ (u a) (applyOperatorToState (A a) (v a))).re|
5979:+        ≤ ∑ a, |(inner ℂ (u a) (applyOperatorToState (A a) (v a))).re| :=
5980:+      Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
5981:+    _ ≤ ∑ a, Real.sqrt (inner ℂ (u a) (applyOperatorToState (A a) (u a))).re *
5982:+          Real.sqrt (inner ℂ (v a) (applyOperatorToState (A a) (v a))).re := by
5983:+      refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ => ?_
5984:+      exact (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans
5985:+        (norm_inner_applyOperatorToState_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt (hA a) (u a) (v a))
5986:+    _ ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ a,
5987:+            Real.sqrt (inner ℂ (u a) (applyOperatorToState (A a) (u a))).re ^ 2) *
5988:+          Real.sqrt (∑ a,
5989:+            Real.sqrt (inner ℂ (v a) (applyOperatorToState (A a) (v a))).re ^ 2) :=
5990:+      Real.sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt _ _ _
5991:+    _ = _ := by
5992:+      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Real.sq_sqrt (hu a),
5993:+        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Real.sq_sqrt (hv a)]
5994:+
5995:+/-- The averaged form of the preceding estimate: the average over a
5996:+distribution of the outcome sums of `Re ⟨u, A v⟩` is bounded by the product of
5997:+the square roots of the two averaged diagonal sums. -/
5998:+theorem abs_avgOver_sum_re_inner_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt {X α ι : Type*} [Fintype α]
5999:+    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (μ : Distribution X) (A : X → α → Op ι)
6000:+    (hA : ∀ x a, 0 ≤ A x a) (u v : X → α → EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
6001:+    |avgOver μ (fun x =>
6002:+        ∑ a, (inner ℂ (u x a) (applyOperatorToState (A x a) (v x a))).re)| ≤
6003:+      Real.sqrt (avgOver μ (fun x =>
6004:+          ∑ a, (inner ℂ (u x a) (applyOperatorToState (A x a) (u x a))).re)) *
6005:+        Real.sqrt (avgOver μ (fun x =>
6006:+          ∑ a, (inner ℂ (v x a) (applyOperatorToState (A x a) (v x a))).re)) := by
6007:+  set f : X → ℝ := fun x =>
6008:+    ∑ a, (inner ℂ (u x a) (applyOperatorToState (A x a) (v x a))).re with hf
6009:+  set g : X → ℝ := fun x =>
6010:+    ∑ a, (inner ℂ (u x a) (applyOperatorToState (A x a) (u x a))).re with hg
6011:+  set h : X → ℝ := fun x =>
6012:+    ∑ a, (inner ℂ (v x a) (applyOperatorToState (A x a) (v x a))).re with hh
6013:+  have hg0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ g x := fun x =>
6014:+    Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ => stateQForm_nonneg (u x a) (hA x a)
6015:+  have hh0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ h x := fun x =>
6016:+    Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ => stateQForm_nonneg (v x a) (hA x a)
6017:+  have hpoint : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ Real.sqrt (g x) * Real.sqrt (h x) := fun x =>
6018:+    abs_sum_re_inner_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt (A x) (hA x) (u x) (v x)
6019:+  unfold avgOver
6020:+  calc
6021:+    |∑ x ∈ μ.support, μ.weight x * f x|
6022:+        ≤ ∑ x ∈ μ.support, |μ.weight x * f x| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
6023:+    _ = ∑ x ∈ μ.support, μ.weight x * |f x| := by
6024:+      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
6025:+      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (μ.nonnegative x)]
6026:+    _ ≤ ∑ x ∈ μ.support, μ.weight x * (Real.sqrt (g x) * Real.sqrt (h x)) :=
6027:+      Finset.sum_le_sum fun x _ =>
6028:+        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hpoint x) (μ.nonnegative x)
6029:+    _ = ∑ x ∈ μ.support,
6030:+          Real.sqrt (μ.weight x * g x) * Real.sqrt (μ.weight x * h x) := by
6031:+      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
6032:+      rw [Real.sqrt_mul (μ.nonnegative x), Real.sqrt_mul (μ.nonnegative x),
6033:+        show Real.sqrt (μ.weight x) * Real.sqrt (g x) *
6034:+            (Real.sqrt (μ.weight x) * Real.sqrt (h x)) =
6035:+          Real.sqrt (μ.weight x) * Real.sqrt (μ.weight x) *
6036:+            (Real.sqrt (g x) * Real.sqrt (h x)) by ring,
6037:+        Real.mul_self_sqrt (μ.nonnegative x)]
6038:+    _ ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ x ∈ μ.support, Real.sqrt (μ.weight x * g x) ^ 2) *
6039:+          Real.sqrt (∑ x ∈ μ.support, Real.sqrt (μ.weight x * h x) ^ 2) :=
6040:+      Real.sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt _ _ _
6041:+    _ = _ := by
6042:+      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ =>
6043:+          Real.sq_sqrt (mul_nonneg (μ.nonnegative x) (hg0 x)),
6044:+        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ =>
6045:+          Real.sq_sqrt (mul_nonneg (μ.nonnegative x) (hh0 x))]
6046:+
6047:+/-! ## Quadratic forms against projections -/
6048:+
6049:+/-- The real quadratic form is invariant under the conjugate transpose. -/
6050:+theorem stateQForm_conjTranspose {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
6051:+    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (M : Op ι) :
6052:+    stateQForm ψ Mᴴ = stateQForm ψ M := by
6053:+  unfold stateQForm
6054:+  change (inner ℂ ψ (Matrix.toEuclideanLin Mᴴ ψ)).re =
6055:+    (inner ℂ ψ (Matrix.toEuclideanLin M ψ)).re
6056:+  rw [Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_eq_adjoint, LinearMap.adjoint_inner_right,
6057:+    ← inner_conj_symm, Complex.conj_re]
6058:+
6059:+/-- Conjugating an operator transfers the outer operator to the state vector. -/
6060:+theorem stateQForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
6061:+    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (W M : Op ι) :
6062:+    stateQForm ψ (Wᴴ * M * W) = stateQForm (applyOperatorToState W ψ) M := by
6063:+  unfold stateQForm
6064:+  rw [applyOperatorToState_mul, applyOperatorToState_mul]
6065:+  congr 1
6066:+  change inner ℂ ψ (Matrix.toEuclideanLin Wᴴ _) =
6067:+    inner ℂ (Matrix.toEuclideanLin W ψ) _
6068:+  rw [Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_eq_adjoint, LinearMap.adjoint_inner_right]
6069:+
6070:+/-- For a projection `B` commuting with `A`, the quadratic form of `A` in
6071:+`B ψ` is the quadratic form of `A B` in `ψ`. -/
6072:+theorem stateQForm_applyOperatorToState_eq_of_isProj {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
6073:+    [DecidableEq ι] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) {A B : Op ι} (hB : IsProj B)
6074:+    (hAB : Commute A B) :
6075:+    stateQForm (applyOperatorToState B ψ) A = stateQForm ψ (A * B) := by
6076:+  rw [← stateQForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul, hB.isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq,
6077:+    ← hAB.eq, mul_assoc, hB.isIdempotentElem.eq]
6078:+
6079:+/-- The quadratic form of an operator bounded by the identity is bounded by
6080:+the squared norm of the vector. -/
6081:+theorem stateQForm_le_norm_sq_of_le_one {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
6082:+    (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) {A : Op ι} (hA : A ≤ 1) :
6083:+    stateQForm v A ≤ ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
6084:+  rw [← stateQForm_one]
6085:+  exact quadratic_form_mono hA v
6086:+
6087:+/-- The effects of a complete measurement have total quadratic form one on a
6088:+unit vector. -/
6089:+theorem sum_stateQForm_effect_eq_one {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype ι]
6090:+    [DecidableEq ι] (A : Measurement α ι) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι)
6091:+    (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1) :
6092:+    (∑ a : α, stateQForm ψ (A.effect a)) = 1 := by
6093:+  calc
6094:+    (∑ a : α, stateQForm ψ (A.effect a)) =
6095:+        stateQForm ψ (∑ a : α, A.effect a) := by
6096:+      simp [stateQForm, applyOperatorToState]
6097:+    _ = stateQForm ψ 1 := by rw [A.sum_eq_one]
6098:+    _ = 1 := by rw [stateQForm_one, hψ, one_pow]
6099:+
6100:+/-- Weighting a complete measurement by commuting projections cannot exceed
6101:+the total mass one. -/
6102:+theorem avgOver_sum_stateQForm_mul_le_one {X α ι : Type*} [Fintype α]
6103:+    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (μ : Distribution X) (A : X → Measurement α ι)
6104:+    (C : X → α → Op ι) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (hμ : μ.IsProbability)
6105:+    (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1) (hC : ∀ x a, IsProj (C x a))
6106:+    (hAC : ∀ x a, Commute ((A x).effect a) (C x a)) :
6107:+    avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * C x a)) ≤ 1 := by
6108:+  have hpt : ∀ x, (∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * C x a)) ≤ 1 := by
6109:+    intro x
6110:+    calc
6111:+      (∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * C x a)) ≤
6112:+          ∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a) := by
6113:+        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ => ?_
6114:+        have h1 : stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * (1 - C x a)) =
6115:+            stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a) -
6116:+              stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * C x a) := by
6117:+          simp [stateQForm, applyOperatorToState, mul_sub]
6118:+        have h2 : 0 ≤ stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * (1 - C x a)) := by
6119:+          rw [← stateQForm_applyOperatorToState_eq_of_isProj ψ (hC x a).one_sub
6120:+            ((Commute.one_right _).sub_right (hAC x a))]
6121:+          exact stateQForm_nonneg _ ((A x).pos a)
6122:+        linarith
6123:+      _ = 1 := sum_stateQForm_effect_eq_one (A x) ψ hψ
6124:+  calc
6125:+    avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * C x a)) ≤
6126:+        avgOver μ (fun _ => 1) := avgOver_mono μ _ _ hpt
6127:+    _ = 1 := avgOver_const_of_isProbability μ hμ 1
6128:+
6129:+/-! ## Replacing a factor under the weight of a measurement -/
6130:+
6131:+/-- Cauchy--Schwarz with the measurement as weight: for projections `B`
6132:+commuting with the effects of `A`, the averaged overlap of `A` against the
6133:+product `B C` is bounded by the square roots of the averaged overlap of `A`
6134:+against `B` and of the averaged quadratic form of `A` in `C ψ`.  This is the
6135:+Cauchy--Schwarz step of the proofs of `lem:claim-17-2` and `lem:claim-17-3`,
6136:+paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1168-1209`. -/
6137:+theorem abs_avgOver_sum_stateQForm_mul_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt {X α ι : Type*}
6138:+    [Fintype α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (μ : Distribution X)
6139:+    (A : X → Measurement α ι) (B C : X → α → Op ι) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι)
6140:+    (hB : ∀ x a, IsProj (B x a))
6141:+    (hAB : ∀ x a, Commute ((A x).effect a) (B x a)) :
6142:+    |avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * (B x a * C x a)))| ≤
6143:+      Real.sqrt (avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * B x a))) *
6144:+        Real.sqrt (avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a,
6145:+          stateQForm (applyOperatorToState (C x a) ψ) ((A x).effect a))) := by
6146:+  have hrw : ∀ x a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * (B x a * C x a)) =
6147:+      (inner ℂ (applyOperatorToState (B x a) ψ)
6148:+        (applyOperatorToState ((A x).effect a)
6149:+          (applyOperatorToState (C x a) ψ))).re := by
6150:+    intro x a
6151:+    unfold stateQForm
6152:+    rw [← mul_assoc, (hAB x a).eq, mul_assoc, applyOperatorToState_mul,
6153:+      applyOperatorToState_mul]
6154:+    congr 1
6155:+    have hadj : (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (B x a)).adjoint =
6156:+        Matrix.toEuclideanLin (B x a) := by
6157:+      rw [← Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_eq_adjoint,
6158:+        (hB x a).isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq]
6159:+    have h := LinearMap.adjoint_inner_right (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (B x a)) ψ
6160:+      (applyOperatorToState ((A x).effect a) (applyOperatorToState (C x a) ψ))
6161:+    rw [hadj] at h
6162:+    exact h
6163:+  have hleft : (fun x => ∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * B x a)) =
6164:+      fun x => ∑ a, (inner ℂ (applyOperatorToState (B x a) ψ)
6165:+        (applyOperatorToState ((A x).effect a)
6166:+          (applyOperatorToState (B x a) ψ))).re :=
6167:+    funext fun x => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ =>
6168:+      (stateQForm_applyOperatorToState_eq_of_isProj ψ (hB x a) (hAB x a)).symm
6169:+  have hmain : (fun x => ∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * (B x a * C x a))) =
6170:+      fun x => ∑ a, (inner ℂ (applyOperatorToState (B x a) ψ)
6171:+        (applyOperatorToState ((A x).effect a)
6172:+          (applyOperatorToState (C x a) ψ))).re :=
6173:+    funext fun x => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => hrw x a
6174:+  rw [hmain, hleft]
6175:+  exact abs_avgOver_sum_re_inner_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt μ (fun x a => (A x).effect a)
6176:+    (fun x a => (A x).pos a) (fun x a => applyOperatorToState (B x a) ψ)
6177:+    (fun x a => applyOperatorToState (C x a) ψ)
6178:+
6179:+/-- Deficit form of the Cauchy--Schwarz estimate: for projections `B` and `C`
6180:+commuting with the effects of `A`, replacing the factor `C B` by `C` inside an
6181:+overlap weighted by the complete measurement `A` changes the average by at
6182:+most the square root of the deficit `1 - E Σ_a ⟨A_a B_a⟩`.  This is the
6183:+estimate used in the proof of `lem:claim-17-2` and, with `C = Id`, in the proof
6184:+of `lem:claim-17-3`, paper
6185:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1168-1209`. -/
6186:+theorem abs_overlap_gap_le_sqrt_one_sub_of_isProj {X α ι : Type*} [Fintype α]
6187:+    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (μ : Distribution X) (A : X → Measurement α ι)
6188:+    (B C : X → α → Op ι) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (hμ : μ.IsProbability)
6189:+    (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1) (hB : ∀ x a, IsProj (B x a)) (hC : ∀ x a, IsProj (C x a))
6190:+    (hAB : ∀ x a, Commute ((A x).effect a) (B x a))
6191:+    (hAC : ∀ x a, Commute ((A x).effect a) (C x a)) :
6192:+    |avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * (C x a * B x a))) -
6193:+        avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * C x a))| ≤
6194:+      Real.sqrt (1 - avgOver μ (fun x =>
6195:+        ∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * B x a))) := by
6196:+  have hpt : ∀ x, (∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * C x a)) -
6197:+      (∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * (C x a * B x a))) =
6198:+        ∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * (C x a * (1 - B x a))) := by
6199:+    intro x
6200:+    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
6201:+    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
6202:+    simp [stateQForm, applyOperatorToState, mul_sub]
6203:+  rw [abs_sub_comm, ← avgOver_sub, avgOver_congr μ _ _ hpt]
6204:+  have h1B : ∀ x a, IsProj (1 - B x a) := fun x a => (hB x a).one_sub
6205:+  have hA1B : ∀ x a, Commute ((A x).effect a) (1 - B x a) := fun x a =>
6206:+    (Commute.one_right _).sub_right (hAB x a)
6207:+  have hcs := abs_avgOver_sum_stateQForm_mul_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt μ A C
6208:+    (fun x a => 1 - B x a) ψ hC hAC
6209:+  have hsecond : avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a,
6210:+      stateQForm (applyOperatorToState (1 - B x a) ψ) ((A x).effect a)) =
6211:+      1 - avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * B x a)) := by
6212:+    have hx : ∀ x, (∑ a,
6213:+        stateQForm (applyOperatorToState (1 - B x a) ψ) ((A x).effect a)) =
6214:+        1 - ∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * B x a) := by
6215:+      intro x
6216:+      rw [← sum_stateQForm_effect_eq_one (A x) ψ hψ, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
6217:+      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
6218:+      rw [stateQForm_applyOperatorToState_eq_of_isProj ψ (h1B x a) (hA1B x a)]
6219:+      simp [stateQForm, applyOperatorToState, mul_sub]
6220:+    rw [avgOver_congr μ _ _ hx, avgOver_sub, avgOver_const_of_isProbability μ hμ]
6221:+  have hfirst : Real.sqrt (avgOver μ (fun x =>
6222:+      ∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * C x a))) ≤ 1 := by
6223:+    rw [← Real.sqrt_one]
6224:+    exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
6225:+      (avgOver_sum_stateQForm_mul_le_one μ A C ψ hμ hψ hC hAC)
6226:+  rw [hsecond] at hcs
6227:+  calc
6228:+    _ ≤ _ := hcs
6229:+    _ ≤ 1 * Real.sqrt (1 - avgOver μ (fun x =>
6230:+          ∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * B x a))) :=
6231:+      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hfirst (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
6232:+    _ = _ := one_mul _
6233:+
6234:+/-- The deficit form of the Cauchy--Schwarz estimate with the product family
6235:+`C B` supplied as one family `CB`, which is convenient when the product is
6236:+formed on a local space before being placed. -/
6237:+theorem abs_overlap_gap_le_sqrt_one_sub_of_isProj' {X α ι : Type*} [Fintype α]
6238:+    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (μ : Distribution X) (A : X → Measurement α ι)
6239:+    (B C CB : X → α → Op ι) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (hμ : μ.IsProbability)
6240:+    (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1) (hB : ∀ x a, IsProj (B x a)) (hC : ∀ x a, IsProj (C x a))
6241:+    (hAB : ∀ x a, Commute ((A x).effect a) (B x a))
6242:+    (hAC : ∀ x a, Commute ((A x).effect a) (C x a))
6243:+    (hCB : ∀ x a, CB x a = C x a * B x a) :
6244:+    |avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * CB x a)) -
6245:+        avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * C x a))| ≤
6246:+      Real.sqrt (1 - avgOver μ (fun x =>
6247:+        ∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * B x a))) := by
6248:+  rw [avgOver_congr μ _ _ fun x => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => by rw [hCB]]
6249:+  exact abs_overlap_gap_le_sqrt_one_sub_of_isProj μ A B C ψ hμ hψ hB hC hAB hAC
6250:+
6251:+/-- Inserting an arbitrary operator family `W` after a projection family `R`
6252:+commuting with the effects of `A` costs at most the square root of the
6253:+averaged squared norms of `W ψ`. -/
6254:+theorem abs_avgOver_sum_stateQForm_mul_le_sqrt_of_isProj {X α ι : Type*}
6255:+    [Fintype α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (μ : Distribution X)
6256:+    (A : X → Measurement α ι) (R W : X → α → Op ι) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι)
6257:+    (hμ : μ.IsProbability) (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1) (hR : ∀ x a, IsProj (R x a))
6258:+    (hAR : ∀ x a, Commute ((A x).effect a) (R x a)) :
6259:+    |avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * (R x a * W x a)))| ≤
6260:+      Real.sqrt (avgOver μ (fun x =>
6261:+        ∑ a, ‖applyOperatorToState (W x a) ψ‖ ^ 2)) := by
6262:+  have hcs := abs_avgOver_sum_stateQForm_mul_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt μ A R W ψ hR hAR
6263:+  have hfirst : Real.sqrt (avgOver μ (fun x =>
6264:+      ∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * R x a))) ≤ 1 := by
6265:+    rw [← Real.sqrt_one]
6266:+    exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
6267:+      (avgOver_sum_stateQForm_mul_le_one μ A R ψ hμ hψ hR hAR)
6268:+  have hsecond : avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a,
6269:+      stateQForm (applyOperatorToState (W x a) ψ) ((A x).effect a)) ≤
6270:+      avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a, ‖applyOperatorToState (W x a) ψ‖ ^ 2) :=
6271:+    avgOver_mono μ _ _ fun x => Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ =>
6272:+      stateQForm_le_norm_sq_of_le_one _ (measurement_effect_le_one (A x) a)
6273:+  calc
6274:+    _ ≤ _ := hcs
6275:+    _ ≤ 1 * Real.sqrt (avgOver μ (fun x =>
6276:+          ∑ a, ‖applyOperatorToState (W x a) ψ‖ ^ 2)) :=
6277:+      mul_le_mul hfirst (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hsecond) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
6278:+        zero_le_one
6279:+    _ = _ := one_mul _
6280:+
6281:+/-- The mirror image of the preceding estimate: an operator family `W`
6282:+commuting with the effects of `A`, inserted before a commuting projection
6283:+family `R`, costs at most the square root of the averaged squared norms of
6284:+`Wᴴ ψ`. -/
6285:+theorem abs_avgOver_sum_stateQForm_mul_le_sqrt_of_isProj' {X α ι : Type*}
6286:+    [Fintype α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (μ : Distribution X)
6287:+    (A : X → Measurement α ι) (W R : X → α → Op ι) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι)
6288:+    (hμ : μ.IsProbability) (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1) (hR : ∀ x a, IsProj (R x a))
6289:+    (hAR : ∀ x a, Commute ((A x).effect a) (R x a))
6290:+    (hAW : ∀ x a, Commute ((A x).effect a) (W x a)) :
6291:+    |avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * (W x a * R x a)))| ≤
6292:+      Real.sqrt (avgOver μ (fun x =>

6320:+/-!
6321:+# Placement calculus on the expanded state
6322:+
6323:+This module records the algebra of the four register placements used by the
6324:+combining argument: a placement is a unital `*`-homomorphism, placements on
6325:+opposite register pairs commute, and the crosswise exchange of the two EPR
6326:+pairs of the expanded state carries the placement `AA'` to `AB''` and `BA''`
6327:+to `BB'` while fixing the expanded state.  The last fact transfers every
6328:+state-dependent distance between the two bipartition schemes of
6329:+`def:symmetric-equivalents` without assuming a symmetric strategy.
6330:+
6331:+## References
6332:+
6333:+The placements are those of `def:symmetric-equivalents`, blueprint
6334:+`blueprint/src/chapter/ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:1003-1030`, paper
6335:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:420-450`.  The
6336:+EPR-exchange invariance is the element `U_σ U_θ` of
6337:+`lem:symmetric-equivalents-transfer`, blueprint
6338:+`blueprint/src/chapter/ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:1032-1130`, which needs no
6339:+symmetry of the strategy; its use for `lem:qld-4-10` is analyzed in
6340:+`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_linearity-theorem-quotation.tex`.
6341:+-/
6342:+
